172// Tile rectangle of a splat of integer bounding `radius`, identical to the
77 return transformed;173// reference rasterizer.
174GS_HD TileRect RectFor(float2 xy, int radius, const TileGrid& grid) {
175 const float r = static_cast<float>(radius);
176 auto lo = [](float v, int n) {
177 return min(n, max(0, static_cast<int>(v / kTileSize)));
178 };
179 auto hi = [](float v, int n) {
180 return min(n, max(0, static_cast<int>((v + kTileSize - 1) / kTileSize)));
181 };
182 return {lo(xy.x - r, grid.tiles_x), lo(xy.y - r, grid.tiles_y),
183 hi(xy.x + r, grid.tiles_x), hi(xy.y + r, grid.tiles_y)};
78}184}

100__forceinline__ __device__ float dnormvdz(float3 v, float3 dv) {
101 float sum2 = v.x * v.x + v.y * v.y + v.z * v.z;
102 float invsum32 = 1.0f / sqrt(sum2 * sum2 * sum2);
103 float dnormvdz =
104 (-v.x * v.z * dv.x - v.y * v.z * dv.y + (sum2 - v.z * v.z) * dv.z) *
105 invsum32;
106 return dnormvdz;
107}

109__forceinline__ __device__ float3 dnormvdv(float3 v, float3 dv) {
110 float sum2 = v.x * v.x + v.y * v.y + v.z * v.z;
111 float invsum32 = 1.0f / sqrt(sum2 * sum2 * sum2);
112
113 float3 dnormvdv;
114 dnormvdv.x =
115 ((+sum2 - v.x * v.x) * dv.x - v.y * v.x * dv.y - v.z * v.x * dv.z) *
116 invsum32;
117 dnormvdv.y =
118 (-v.x * v.y * dv.x + (sum2 - v.y * v.y) * dv.y - v.z * v.y * dv.z) *
119 invsum32;
120 dnormvdv.z =
121 (-v.x * v.z * dv.x - v.y * v.z * dv.y + (sum2 - v.z * v.z) * dv.z) *
122 invsum32;
123 return dnormvdv;
124}

126__forceinline__ __device__ float4 dnormvdv(float4 v, float4 dv) {
127 float sum2 = v.x * v.x + v.y * v.y + v.z * v.z + v.w * v.w;
128 float invsum32 = 1.0f / sqrt(sum2 * sum2 * sum2);
129
130 float4 vdv = {v.x * dv.x, v.y * dv.y, v.z * dv.z, v.w * dv.w};
131 float vdv_sum = vdv.x + vdv.y + vdv.z + vdv.w;
132 float4 dnormvdv;
133 dnormvdv.x = ((sum2 - v.x * v.x) * dv.x - v.x * (vdv_sum - vdv.x)) * invsum32;
134 dnormvdv.y = ((sum2 - v.y * v.y) * dv.y - v.y * (vdv_sum - vdv.y)) * invsum32;
135 dnormvdv.z = ((sum2 - v.z * v.z) * dv.z - v.z * (vdv_sum - vdv.z)) * invsum32;
136 dnormvdv.w = ((sum2 - v.w * v.w) * dv.w - v.w * (vdv_sum - vdv.w)) * invsum32;
137 return dnormvdv;
138}

205// Pad (pixels) on ellipse extents, against rounding.
206inline constexpr float kSpanPadPx = 0.01f;
207
208// Precomputed splat-level ellipse constants for fast band intersection tests
209// of {q(d) <= limit}, where q(d) = a dx^2 + 2 b dx dy + c dy^2.
210struct EllipseBounds {
211 float a, b, c;
212 float det;
213 float inv_a;
214 float a_limit;
215 float y_ext;
216 float dy_peak;
217
218 GS_D static bool Init(float3 conic, float opacity, float cached_limit,
219 EllipseBounds& out) {
220 float limit = cached_limit;
221 if (limit <= 0.0f && !AlphaLimit(opacity, limit)) return false;
222 out.a = conic.x;
223 out.b = conic.y;
224 out.c = conic.z;
225 out.det = out.a * out.c - out.b * out.b;
226 if (!(out.det > 0.0f && out.a > 0.0f && out.c > 0.0f)) return false;
227 out.inv_a = 1.0f / out.a;
228 out.a_limit = out.a * limit;
229 const float limit_over_det = limit / out.det;
230 out.y_ext = sqrtf(out.a * limit_over_det);
231 out.dy_peak = out.b * sqrtf(limit_over_det / out.c);
232 return true;
233 }
234
235 // Span [x0_px, x1_px] of integer pixel columns hit across integer pixel rows
236 // Y in [y0_px, y1_px] (inclusive). Returns false if no integer pixel hits.
237 GS_D bool SpanForPixelRows(float2 xy, int y0_px, int y1_px, int& x0_px,
238 int& x1_px) const {
239 const int ylo_i =
240 max(y0_px, static_cast<int>(ceilf(xy.y - y_ext - kSpanPadPx)));
241 const int yhi_i =
242 min(y1_px, static_cast<int>(floorf(xy.y + y_ext + kSpanPadPx)));
243 if (ylo_i > yhi_i) return false;
244 const float ylo = static_cast<float>(ylo_i) - xy.y;
245 const float yhi = static_cast<float>(yhi_i) - xy.y;
246 // Boundary x(dy) = (-b dy +- sqrt(a limit - det dy^2)) / a; the right
247 // (left) branch is concave (convex) and peaks at dy = -+dy_peak.
248 const float dyr = fminf(yhi, fmaxf(ylo, -dy_peak));
249 const float dyl = fminf(yhi, fmaxf(ylo, dy_peak));
250 const float dyr2 = dyr * dyr, dyl2 = dyl * dyl;
251 const float rr = sqrtf(fmaxf(0.0f, a_limit - det * dyr2));
252 const float rl =
253 (dyr2 == dyl2) ? rr : sqrtf(fmaxf(0.0f, a_limit - det * dyl2));
254 const float hi = (-b * dyr + rr) * inv_a;
255 const float lo = (-b * dyl - rl) * inv_a;
256 x0_px = static_cast<int>(ceilf(xy.x + lo - kSpanPadPx));
257 x1_px = static_cast<int>(floorf(xy.x + hi + kSpanPadPx));
258 return x0_px <= x1_px;
259 }
260};
261
262// Visits every tile row `ty` with the half-open span [tx0, tx1) of tiles that
263// splat `s` (not culled) is binned to. Rows may be empty (tx0 >= tx1).
264template <Culling kCulling, typename Fn>
265GS_D void ForEachTileRow(const Splat& s, const TileGrid& grid, int width,
266 int height, Fn&& fn) {
267 const float2 xy = s.xy();
268 const TileRect rect = RectFor(xy, s.radius(), grid);
269 if constexpr (kCulling == Culling::kRect) {
270 for (int ty = rect.y0; ty < rect.y1; ++ty) fn(ty, rect.x0, rect.x1);
271 } else {
272 EllipseBounds eb;
273 if (!EllipseBounds::Init(s.conic(), s.opacity(), s.limit(), eb)) return;
274 const int min_y =
275 max(0, static_cast<int>(ceilf(xy.y - eb.y_ext - kSpanPadPx)));
276 const int max_y =
277 min(height - 1, static_cast<int>(floorf(xy.y + eb.y_ext + kSpanPadPx)));
278 if (min_y > max_y) return;
279 const int ty0 = max(rect.y0, min_y / kTileSize);
280 const int ty1 = min(rect.y1, (max_y / kTileSize) + 1);
281 for (int ty = ty0; ty < ty1; ++ty) {
282 int x0_px, x1_px;
283 if (!eb.SpanForPixelRows(xy, ty * kTileSize,
284 min((ty + 1) * kTileSize, height) - 1, x0_px,
285 x1_px)) {
286 continue;
287 }
288 x0_px = max(0, x0_px);
289 x1_px = min(width - 1, x1_px);
290 if (x0_px > x1_px) continue;
291 const int tx0 = max(rect.x0, x0_px / kTileSize);
292 const int tx1 = min(rect.x1, (x1_px / kTileSize) + 1);
293 if (tx0 < tx1) fn(ty, tx0, tx1);
294 }
295 }

300inline constexpr unsigned kFullMask = 0xffffffffu;
301
302// Standard warp butterfly reduction of an array of `N` per-lane values:
303// 5 steps of `__shfl_xor_sync` for each element (`5 * N` shuffles total),
304// after which lane 0 (and every other lane) holds the warp sum of `v[0..N)`.
305template <int N>
306GS_D void ButterflyReduce(float (&v)[N]) {
307#pragma unroll
308 for (int offset = 16; offset >= 1; offset >>= 1) {
309#pragma unroll
310 for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
311 v[i] += __shfl_xor_sync(kFullMask, v[i], offset);
312 }
313 }
314}

321inline constexpr float kFovClamp = 1.3f;

323// Pointers to the trainable parameters, all activated, row-major.
324struct GaussianParams {
325 const float* means; // (N, 3)
326 const float* scales; // (N, 3)
327 const float* quats; // (N, 4) as (w, x, y, z), not normalized.
328 const float* opacities; // (N,)

342// Screen-space quantities needed by rasterization. `conic` is the inverse 2D
343// covariance (a, b, c) with power = -0.5 (a dx^2 + c dy^2) - b dx dy.
344struct Projection {
345 float2 xy;
346 float depth;

354// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
355// SH coefficient storage. A row holds the 16 x 3 coefficients of one Gaussian
356// and may be stored as f32 or as bf16 (raw bits, `ShBf16`); math is always f32.
357
358using ShBf16 = uint16_t; // bfloat16 bits.
359
360template <typename T>
361struct ShIo;
362
363template <>
364struct ShIo<float> {
365 GS_D static void LoadRow(const float* row, float3 coeffs[kShCoeffs]) {
366 const float4* p = reinterpret_cast<const float4*>(row);
367 float raw[3 * kShCoeffs];
368#pragma unroll
369 for (int k = 0; k < 12; ++k) {
370 const float4 q = __ldg(p + k);
371 raw[4 * k] = q.x;
372 raw[4 * k + 1] = q.y;
373 raw[4 * k + 2] = q.z;
374 raw[4 * k + 3] = q.w;
375 }
376#pragma unroll
377 for (int c = 0; c < kShCoeffs; ++c) {
378 coeffs[c] = {raw[3 * c], raw[3 * c + 1], raw[3 * c + 2]};
379 }
380 }
381 GS_D static void StoreRow(float* row, const float3 dsh[kShCoeffs]) {
382 float raw[3 * kShCoeffs];
383#pragma unroll
384 for (int c = 0; c < kShCoeffs; ++c) {
385 raw[3 * c] = dsh[c].x;
386 raw[3 * c + 1] = dsh[c].y;
387 raw[3 * c + 2] = dsh[c].z;
388 }
389 float4* p = reinterpret_cast<float4*>(row);
390#pragma unroll
391 for (int k = 0; k < 12; ++k) {
392 p[k] = {raw[4 * k], raw[4 * k + 1], raw[4 * k + 2], raw[4 * k + 3]};
393 }
394 }
395};
396
397template <>
398struct ShIo<ShBf16> {
399 GS_D static float Lo(uint32_t w) { return __uint_as_float(w << 16); }
400 GS_D static float Hi(uint32_t w) { return __uint_as_float(w & 0xffff0000u); }
401 // Round to nearest even (inputs are finite).
402 GS_D static uint32_t Round(float f) {
403 const uint32_t u = __float_as_uint(f);
404 return (u + 0x7fffu + ((u >> 16) & 1u)) >> 16;
405 }
406 GS_D static uint32_t Pack(float lo, float hi) {
407 return Round(lo) | (Round(hi) << 16);
408 }
409 GS_D static void LoadRow(const ShBf16* row, float3 coeffs[kShCoeffs]) {
410 const uint2* p = reinterpret_cast<const uint2*>(row);
411 float raw[3 * kShCoeffs];
412#pragma unroll
413 for (int k = 0; k < 12; ++k) {
414 const uint2 w = __ldg(p + k);
415 raw[4 * k] = Lo(w.x);
416 raw[4 * k + 1] = Hi(w.x);
417 raw[4 * k + 2] = Lo(w.y);
418 raw[4 * k + 3] = Hi(w.y);
419 }
420#pragma unroll
421 for (int c = 0; c < kShCoeffs; ++c) {
422 coeffs[c] = {raw[3 * c], raw[3 * c + 1], raw[3 * c + 2]};
423 }
424 }
425 GS_D static void StoreRow(ShBf16* row, const float3 dsh[kShCoeffs]) {
426 float raw[3 * kShCoeffs];
427#pragma unroll
428 for (int c = 0; c < kShCoeffs; ++c) {
429 raw[3 * c] = dsh[c].x;
430 raw[3 * c + 1] = dsh[c].y;
431 raw[3 * c + 2] = dsh[c].z;
432 }
433 uint2* p = reinterpret_cast<uint2*>(row);
434#pragma unroll
435 for (int k = 0; k < 12; ++k) {
436 p[k] = {Pack(raw[4 * k], raw[4 * k + 1]),
437 Pack(raw[4 * k + 2], raw[4 * k + 3])};
438 }
439 }
440};
441
442template <typename ShT>
443GS_D const ShT* ShRow(const void* sh, int i) {
444 return static_cast<const ShT*>(sh) + static_cast<size_t>(i) * 3 * kShCoeffs;
445}
446template <typename ShT>
447GS_D ShT* ShRow(void* sh, int i) {
448 return static_cast<ShT*>(sh) + static_cast<size_t>(i) * 3 * kShCoeffs;
449}

451// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
452// Spherical harmonics (degree 3, Inria sign convention).
453
454namespace sh {
455inline constexpr float kC0 = 0.28209479177387814f;
456inline constexpr float kC1 = 0.4886025119029199f;
457inline constexpr float kC2[5] = {1.0925484305920792f, -1.0925484305920792f,
458 0.31539156525252005f, -1.0925484305920792f,
459 0.5462742152960396f};
460inline constexpr float kC3[7] = {-0.5900435899266435f, 2.890611442640554f,
461 -0.4570457994644658f, 0.3731763325901154f,
462 -0.4570457994644658f, 1.445305721320277f,
463 -0.5900435899266435f};
464
465// Basis values for a unit direction.
466GS_D void Basis(float3 d, float b[kShCoeffs]) {
467 const float x = d.x, y = d.y, z = d.z;
468 const float xx = x * x, yy = y * y, zz = z * z;
469 b[0] = kC0;
470 b[1] = -kC1 * y;
471 b[2] = kC1 * z;
472 b[3] = -kC1 * x;
473 b[4] = kC2[0] * x * y;
474 b[5] = kC2[1] * y * z;
475 b[6] = kC2[2] * (2.0f * zz - xx - yy);
476 b[7] = kC2[3] * x * z;
477 b[8] = kC2[4] * (xx - yy);
478 b[9] = kC3[0] * y * (3.0f * xx - yy);
479 b[10] = kC3[1] * x * y * z;
480 b[11] = kC3[2] * y * (4.0f * zz - xx - yy);
481 b[12] = kC3[3] * z * (2.0f * zz - 3.0f * xx - 3.0f * yy);
482 b[13] = kC3[4] * x * (4.0f * zz - xx - yy);
483 b[14] = kC3[5] * z * (xx - yy);
484 b[15] = kC3[6] * x * (xx - 3.0f * yy);
485}
486
487// Partial derivatives of every basis function w.r.t. (x, y, z) of the unit
488// direction (treated as free coordinates).
489GS_D void BasisGrad(float3 d, float3 g[kShCoeffs]) {
490 const float x = d.x, y = d.y, z = d.z;
491 const float xx = x * x, yy = y * y, zz = z * z;
492 g[0] = {0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
493 g[1] = {0.0f, -kC1, 0.0f};
494 g[2] = {0.0f, 0.0f, kC1};
495 g[3] = {-kC1, 0.0f, 0.0f};
496 g[4] = kC2[0] * float3{y, x, 0.0f};
497 g[5] = kC2[1] * float3{0.0f, z, y};
498 g[6] = kC2[2] * float3{-2.0f * x, -2.0f * y, 4.0f * z};
499 g[7] = kC2[3] * float3{z, 0.0f, x};
500 g[8] = kC2[4] * float3{2.0f * x, -2.0f * y, 0.0f};
501 g[9] = kC3[0] * float3{6.0f * x * y, 3.0f * (xx - yy), 0.0f};
502 g[10] = kC3[1] * float3{y * z, x * z, x * y};
503 g[11] =
504 kC3[2] * float3{-2.0f * x * y, 4.0f * zz - xx - 3.0f * yy, 8.0f * y * z};
505 g[12] = kC3[3] * float3{-6.0f * x * z, -6.0f * y * z,
506 6.0f * zz - 3.0f * xx - 3.0f * yy};
507 g[13] =
508 kC3[4] * float3{4.0f * zz - 3.0f * xx - yy, -2.0f * x * y, 8.0f * x * z};
509 g[14] = kC3[5] * float3{2.0f * x * z, -2.0f * y * z, xx - yy};
510 g[15] = kC3[6] * float3{3.0f * (xx - yy), -6.0f * x * y, 0.0f};
511}
512
513// Pre-clamp color 0.5 + sum_k b_k sh_k, loading the full 16-basis SH row.
514template <typename ShT>
515GS_D float3 EvalRow(const ShT* __restrict__ sh_row, const float b[kShCoeffs]) {
516 float3 coeffs[kShCoeffs];
517 ShIo<ShT>::LoadRow(sh_row, coeffs);
518 float3 c = {0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f};
519#pragma unroll
520 for (int k = 0; k < kShCoeffs; ++k) {
521 c += b[k] * coeffs[k];
522 }
523 return c;
524}
525} // namespace sh

527// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
528// Covariance helpers.
529
530// Standard rotation matrix of the (unnormalized) quaternion (w, x, y, z).
531GS_D Mat3 QuatToRotation(float4 q) {
532 const float w = q.x, x = q.y, y = q.z, z = q.w;
533 Mat3 r;
534 r.m[0][0] = 1.0f - 2.0f * (y * y + z * z);
535 r.m[0][1] = 2.0f * (x * y - w * z);
536 r.m[0][2] = 2.0f * (x * z + w * y);
537 r.m[1][0] = 2.0f * (x * y + w * z);
538 r.m[1][1] = 1.0f - 2.0f * (x * x + z * z);
539 r.m[1][2] = 2.0f * (y * z - w * x);
540 r.m[2][0] = 2.0f * (x * z - w * y);
541 r.m[2][1] = 2.0f * (y * z + w * x);
542 r.m[2][2] = 1.0f - 2.0f * (x * x + y * y);
543 return r;
544}
545
546// Symmetric 3x3 matrix.
547struct Sym3 {
548 float xx, xy, xz, yy, yz, zz;
549 GS_D float3 Mul(float3 v) const {
550 return {xx * v.x + xy * v.y + xz * v.z, xy * v.x + yy * v.y + yz * v.z,
551 xz * v.x + yz * v.y + zz * v.z};
552 }
553};
554
555// Sigma = A A^T with A = R diag(s).
556GS_D Sym3 Covariance3D(const Mat3& r, float3 s) {
557 Mat3 a;
558 const float sv[3] = {s.x, s.y, s.z};
559#pragma unroll
560 for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
561#pragma unroll
562 for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) a.m[i][j] = r.m[i][j] * sv[j];
563 return {dot(a.row(0), a.row(0)), dot(a.row(0), a.row(1)),
564 dot(a.row(0), a.row(2)), dot(a.row(1), a.row(1)),
565 dot(a.row(1), a.row(2)), dot(a.row(2), a.row(2))};
566}
567
568// Intermediate values of the projection shared by forward and VJP.
569struct ProjectionState {
570 float3 t; // View-space mean.
571 float tx_c, ty_c; // Clamped x, y used by the Jacobian.
572 bool x_clamped, y_clamped;
573 float3 m0, m1; // Rows of M = J W (2x3).
574 Sym3 sigma; // World-space 3D covariance.
575 float a, b, c; // Dilated 2D covariance.
576};
577
578// Computes 2D covariance given view-space mean `t` (with t.z > kNearPlane).
579GS_D void ProjectCovarianceFromView(const Camera& cam, float3 t, float3 scale,
580 float4 quat, ProjectionState& st) {
581 st.t = t;
582 const float tz = t.z;
583 const float limx = kFovClamp * cam.TanHalfFovX();
584 const float limy = kFovClamp * cam.TanHalfFovY();
585 const float txtz = t.x / tz, tytz = t.y / tz;
586 st.x_clamped = txtz < -limx || txtz > limx;
587 st.y_clamped = tytz < -limy || tytz > limy;
588 st.tx_c = fminf(limx, fmaxf(-limx, txtz)) * tz;
589 st.ty_c = fminf(limy, fmaxf(-limy, tytz)) * tz;
590 const float j00 = cam.fx / tz, j02 = -cam.fx * st.tx_c / (tz * tz);
591 const float j11 = cam.fy / tz, j12 = -cam.fy * st.ty_c / (tz * tz);
592 const Mat3& w = cam.rotation;
593 st.m0 = j00 * w.row(0) + j02 * w.row(2);
594 st.m1 = j11 * w.row(1) + j12 * w.row(2);
595 st.sigma = Covariance3D(QuatToRotation(quat), scale);
596 const float3 s0 = st.sigma.Mul(st.m0), s1 = st.sigma.Mul(st.m1);
597 st.a = dot(st.m0, s0) + kLowPass;
598 st.b = dot(st.m0, s1);
599 st.c = dot(st.m1, s1) + kLowPass;
600}
601
602// Computes everything up to the 2D covariance. Returns false if culled by the
603// near plane.
604GS_D bool ProjectCovariance(const Camera& cam, float3 mean, float3 scale,
605 float4 quat, ProjectionState& st) {
606 const float3 t = cam.ToView(mean);
607 if (t.z <= kNearPlane) return false;
608 ProjectCovarianceFromView(cam, t, scale, quat, st);
609 return true;
610}
611
612// Integer bounding radius (pixels) of the 2D covariance, as in the reference.
613GS_D int BoundingRadius(float a, float b, float c) {
614 const float det = a * c - b * b;
615 const float mid = 0.5f * (a + c);
616 const float lambda = mid + sqrtf(fmaxf(0.1f, mid * mid - det));
617 return static_cast<int>(ceilf(3.0f * sqrtf(lambda)));
618}
619
620GS_D float2 ProjectMean(const Camera& cam, float3 t) {
621 return {cam.fx * (t.x / t.z) + cam.cx, cam.fy * (t.y / t.z) + cam.cy};
622}
623
624GS_D float3 LoadMean(const GaussianParams& p, int i) {
625 return {p.means[3 * i], p.means[3 * i + 1], p.means[3 * i + 2]};
626}
627
628// Unit direction from the camera center to `mean`, and 1 / distance.
629GS_D float3 ViewDir(const Camera& cam, float3 mean, float& inv_len) {
630 const float3 v = mean - cam.position;
631 inv_len = rsqrtf(dot(v, v));
632 return inv_len * v;
633}

652// Per-Gaussian kernels run one thread per Gaussian.
653
654inline constexpr int kGaussianThreads = 128;
655
656inline int GaussianBlocks(int64_t n) {
657 return static_cast<int>((n + kGaussianThreads - 1) / kGaussianThreads);
658}

660// Base-2 exponent scale: power2 = kPower2Scale * q = (-log2(e)/2) * q.
661inline constexpr float kPower2Scale = -0.72134752044448170f; // -log2(e)/2
662inline constexpr float kInvPower2Scale = 1.0f / kPower2Scale;
663
664GS_HD float3 Power2Conic(float a, float b, float c) {
665 return {kPower2Scale * a, 2.0f * kPower2Scale * b, kPower2Scale * c};
666}

674// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
675// Rasterization. One block per 16x16 tile, one pixel per thread, arranged into
676// eight 8x4 sub-tile warps (`RasterLayout<1>`). Splats are staged through
677// shared memory in batches of 256 with an 8-bit per-warp sub-tile mask.
678
679template <int kRows>
680struct RasterLayout {
681 static_assert(kRows == 1 || kRows == 2 || kRows == 4);
682 static constexpr int kThreads = kTilePixels / kRows;
683 static constexpr int kWarps = kThreads / 32;
684 static constexpr int kWarpWidth = kRows == 4 ? kTileSize : 8;
685 static constexpr int kWarpRows = (32 / kWarpWidth) * kRows;
686 static constexpr int kWarpsX = kTileSize / kWarpWidth;
687 static_assert(kWarpsX * (kTileSize / kWarpRows) == kWarps);
688
689 GS_HD static constexpr int WarpX(int w) { return (w % kWarpsX) * kWarpWidth; }
690 GS_HD static constexpr int WarpY(int w) { return (w / kWarpsX) * kWarpRows; }
691};
692
693struct RasterPixels {
694 int x, y0;
695 template <int kRows>
696 GS_D static RasterPixels For(int tid) {
697 using L = RasterLayout<kRows>;
698 const int warp = tid / 32, lane = tid % 32;
699 return {static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize + L::WarpX(warp) +
700 lane % L::kWarpWidth,
701 static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize + L::WarpY(warp) +
702 (lane / L::kWarpWidth) * kRows};
703 }
704};
705
706// Bit w is set if splat (p0, p1) can reach alpha >= 1/255 somewhere in the
707// pixel region of warp w of this block's tile.
708template <int kRows>
709GS_D uint32_t WarpMask(float4 p0, float4 p1) {
710 using L = RasterLayout<kRows>;
711 constexpr int kWarpsY = L::kWarps / L::kWarpsX;
712 float limit = p1.z;
713 if (limit <= 0.0f && !AlphaLimit(p1.y, limit)) return 0;
714 const float a = p0.z, b = p0.w, c = p1.x;
715 const float det = a * c - b * b;
716 if (!(det > 0.0f && a > 0.0f && c > 0.0f)) return 0;
717 const float l_over_det = limit / det;
718 const float rx = sqrtf(c * l_over_det);
719 const float ry = sqrtf(a * l_over_det);
720 const float2 xy = {p0.x, p0.y};
721 const int x0 = static_cast<int>(ceilf(xy.x - rx - kSpanPadPx));
722 const int x1 = static_cast<int>(floorf(xy.x + rx + kSpanPadPx));
723 const int y0 = static_cast<int>(ceilf(xy.y - ry - kSpanPadPx));
724 const int y1 = static_cast<int>(floorf(xy.y + ry + kSpanPadPx));
725 if (x0 > x1 || y0 > y1) return 0;
726 const int tx = blockIdx.x * kTileSize, ty = blockIdx.y * kTileSize;
727 uint32_t mx = 0u;
728#pragma unroll
729 for (int wx = 0; wx < L::kWarpsX; ++wx) {
730 const int wx0 = tx + wx * L::kWarpWidth;
731 if (x0 <= wx0 + L::kWarpWidth - 1 && x1 >= wx0) mx |= (1u << wx);
732 }
733 if (mx == 0u) return 0;
734 uint32_t my = 0u;
735#pragma unroll
736 for (int wy = 0; wy < kWarpsY; ++wy) {
737 const int wy0 = ty + wy * L::kWarpRows;
738 if (y0 <= wy0 + L::kWarpRows - 1 && y1 >= wy0) my |= (1u << wy);
739 }
740 if (my == 0u) return 0;
741 if ((mx & (mx - 1u)) == 0u || (my & (my - 1u)) == 0u) {
742 uint32_t mask = 0u;
743#pragma unroll
744 for (int wy = 0; wy < kWarpsY; ++wy) {
745 if (!((my >> wy) & 1u)) continue;
746#pragma unroll
747 for (int wx = 0; wx < L::kWarpsX; ++wx) {
748 if ((mx >> wx) & 1u) mask |= (1u << (wy * L::kWarpsX + wx));
749 }
750 }
751 return mask;
752 }
753 EllipseBounds eb;
754 eb.a = a;
755 eb.b = b;
756 eb.c = c;
757 eb.det = det;
758 eb.inv_a = 1.0f / a;
759 eb.a_limit = a * limit;
760 eb.y_ext = ry;
761 eb.dy_peak = b * sqrtf(l_over_det / c);
762 uint32_t mask = 0u;
763#pragma unroll
764 for (int wy = 0; wy < kWarpsY; ++wy) {
765 if (!((my >> wy) & 1u)) continue;
766 const int wy0 = ty + wy * L::kWarpRows;
767 int x0_px, x1_px;
768 if (!eb.SpanForPixelRows(xy, wy0, wy0 + L::kWarpRows - 1, x0_px, x1_px)) {
769 continue;
770 }
771#pragma unroll
772 for (int wx = 0; wx < L::kWarpsX; ++wx) {
773 const int wx0 = tx + wx * L::kWarpWidth;
774 if (x0_px <= wx0 + L::kWarpWidth - 1 && x1_px >= wx0) {
775 mask |= 1u << (wy * L::kWarpsX + wx);
776 }
777 }
778 }
779 return mask;
780}

205+// Pad (pixels) on ellipse extents, against rounding.
206+inline constexpr float kSpanPadPx = 0.01f;
207+
208+// Precomputed splat-level ellipse constants for fast band intersection tests
209+// of {q(d) <= limit}, where q(d) = a dx^2 + 2 b dx dy + c dy^2.
210+struct EllipseBounds {
211+ float a, b, c;
212+ float det;
213+ float inv_a;
214+ float a_limit;
215+ float y_ext;
216+ float dy_peak;
217+
218+ GS_D static bool Init(float3 conic, float opacity, float cached_limit,
219+ EllipseBounds& out) {
220+ float limit = cached_limit;
221+ if (limit <= 0.0f && !AlphaLimit(opacity, limit)) return false;
222+ out.a = conic.x;
223+ out.b = conic.y;
224+ out.c = conic.z;
225+ out.det = out.a * out.c - out.b * out.b;
226+ if (!(out.det > 0.0f && out.a > 0.0f && out.c > 0.0f)) return false;
227+ out.inv_a = 1.0f / out.a;
228+ out.a_limit = out.a * limit;
229+ const float limit_over_det = limit / out.det;
230+ out.y_ext = sqrtf(out.a * limit_over_det);
231+ out.dy_peak = out.b * sqrtf(limit_over_det / out.c);
232+ return true;
233+ }
234+
235+ // Span [x0_px, x1_px] of integer pixel columns hit across integer pixel rows
236+ // Y in [y0_px, y1_px] (inclusive). Returns false if no integer pixel hits.
237+ GS_D bool SpanForPixelRows(float2 xy, int y0_px, int y1_px, int& x0_px,
238+ int& x1_px) const {
239+ const int ylo_i =
240+ max(y0_px, static_cast<int>(ceilf(xy.y - y_ext - kSpanPadPx)));
241+ const int yhi_i =
242+ min(y1_px, static_cast<int>(floorf(xy.y + y_ext + kSpanPadPx)));
243+ if (ylo_i > yhi_i) return false;
244+ const float ylo = static_cast<float>(ylo_i) - xy.y;
245+ const float yhi = static_cast<float>(yhi_i) - xy.y;
246+ // Boundary x(dy) = (-b dy +- sqrt(a limit - det dy^2)) / a; the right
247+ // (left) branch is concave (convex) and peaks at dy = -+dy_peak.
248+ const float dyr = fminf(yhi, fmaxf(ylo, -dy_peak));
249+ const float dyl = fminf(yhi, fmaxf(ylo, dy_peak));
250+ const float dyr2 = dyr * dyr, dyl2 = dyl * dyl;
251+ const float rr = sqrtf(fmaxf(0.0f, a_limit - det * dyr2));
252+ const float rl =
253+ (dyr2 == dyl2) ? rr : sqrtf(fmaxf(0.0f, a_limit - det * dyl2));
254+ const float hi = (-b * dyr + rr) * inv_a;
255+ const float lo = (-b * dyl - rl) * inv_a;
256+ x0_px = static_cast<int>(ceilf(xy.x + lo - kSpanPadPx));
257+ x1_px = static_cast<int>(floorf(xy.x + hi + kSpanPadPx));
258+ return x0_px <= x1_px;
259+ }
260+};

262+// Visits every tile row `ty` with the half-open span [tx0, tx1) of tiles that
263+// splat `s` (not culled) is binned to. Rows may be empty (tx0 >= tx1).
264+template <Culling kCulling, typename Fn>
265+GS_D void ForEachTileRow(const Splat& s, const TileGrid& grid, int width,
266+ int height, Fn&& fn) {
267+ const float2 xy = s.xy();
268+ const TileRect rect = RectFor(xy, s.radius(), grid);
269+ if constexpr (kCulling == Culling::kRect) {
270+ for (int ty = rect.y0; ty < rect.y1; ++ty) fn(ty, rect.x0, rect.x1);
271+ } else {
272+ EllipseBounds eb;
273+ if (!EllipseBounds::Init(s.conic(), s.opacity(), s.limit(), eb)) return;
274+ const int min_y =
275+ max(0, static_cast<int>(ceilf(xy.y - eb.y_ext - kSpanPadPx)));
276+ const int max_y =
277+ min(height - 1, static_cast<int>(floorf(xy.y + eb.y_ext + kSpanPadPx)));
278+ if (min_y > max_y) return;
279+ const int ty0 = max(rect.y0, min_y / kTileSize);
280+ const int ty1 = min(rect.y1, (max_y / kTileSize) + 1);
281+ for (int ty = ty0; ty < ty1; ++ty) {
282+ int x0_px, x1_px;
283+ if (!eb.SpanForPixelRows(xy, ty * kTileSize,
284+ min((ty + 1) * kTileSize, height) - 1, x0_px,
285+ x1_px)) {
286+ continue;
287+ }
288+ x0_px = max(0, x0_px);
289+ x1_px = min(width - 1, x1_px);
290+ if (x0_px > x1_px) continue;
291+ const int tx0 = max(rect.x0, x0_px / kTileSize);
292+ const int tx1 = min(rect.x1, (x1_px / kTileSize) + 1);
293+ if (tx0 < tx1) fn(ty, tx0, tx1);
294+ }
295+ }

300+inline constexpr unsigned kFullMask = 0xffffffffu;
301+
302+// Standard warp butterfly reduction of an array of `N` per-lane values:
303+// 5 steps of `__shfl_xor_sync` for each element (`5 * N` shuffles total),
304+// after which lane 0 (and every other lane) holds the warp sum of `v[0..N)`.
305+template <int N>
306+GS_D void ButterflyReduce(float (&v)[N]) {
307+#pragma unroll
308+ for (int offset = 16; offset >= 1; offset >>= 1) {
309+#pragma unroll
310+ for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
311+ v[i] += __shfl_xor_sync(kFullMask, v[i], offset);
312+ }
313+ }
314+}

342+// Screen-space quantities needed by rasterization. `conic` is the inverse 2D

344+struct Projection {

355+// SH coefficient storage. A row holds the 16 x 3 coefficients of one Gaussian
356+// and may be stored as f32 or as bf16 (raw bits, `ShBf16`); math is always f32.
357+
358+using ShBf16 = uint16_t; // bfloat16 bits.

360+template <typename T>
361+struct ShIo;

363+template <>
364+struct ShIo<float> {
365+ GS_D static void LoadRow(const float* row, float3 coeffs[kShCoeffs]) {
366+ const float4* p = reinterpret_cast<const float4*>(row);
367+ float raw[3 * kShCoeffs];
368+#pragma unroll
369+ for (int k = 0; k < 12; ++k) {
370+ const float4 q = __ldg(p + k);
371+ raw[4 * k] = q.x;
372+ raw[4 * k + 1] = q.y;
373+ raw[4 * k + 2] = q.z;
374+ raw[4 * k + 3] = q.w;
375+ }
376+#pragma unroll
377+ for (int c = 0; c < kShCoeffs; ++c) {
378+ coeffs[c] = {raw[3 * c], raw[3 * c + 1], raw[3 * c + 2]};
379+ }
380+ }
381+ GS_D static void StoreRow(float* row, const float3 dsh[kShCoeffs]) {
382+ float raw[3 * kShCoeffs];
383+#pragma unroll
384+ for (int c = 0; c < kShCoeffs; ++c) {
385+ raw[3 * c] = dsh[c].x;
386+ raw[3 * c + 1] = dsh[c].y;
387+ raw[3 * c + 2] = dsh[c].z;
388+ }
389+ float4* p = reinterpret_cast<float4*>(row);
390+#pragma unroll
391+ for (int k = 0; k < 12; ++k) {
392+ p[k] = {raw[4 * k], raw[4 * k + 1], raw[4 * k + 2], raw[4 * k + 3]};
393+ }
394+ }
395+};

397+template <>
398+struct ShIo<ShBf16> {
399+ GS_D static float Lo(uint32_t w) { return __uint_as_float(w << 16); }
400+ GS_D static float Hi(uint32_t w) { return __uint_as_float(w & 0xffff0000u); }
401+ // Round to nearest even (inputs are finite).
402+ GS_D static uint32_t Round(float f) {
403+ const uint32_t u = __float_as_uint(f);
404+ return (u + 0x7fffu + ((u >> 16) & 1u)) >> 16;
405+ }
406+ GS_D static uint32_t Pack(float lo, float hi) {
407+ return Round(lo) | (Round(hi) << 16);
408+ }
409+ GS_D static void LoadRow(const ShBf16* row, float3 coeffs[kShCoeffs]) {
410+ const uint2* p = reinterpret_cast<const uint2*>(row);
411+ float raw[3 * kShCoeffs];
412+#pragma unroll
413+ for (int k = 0; k < 12; ++k) {
414+ const uint2 w = __ldg(p + k);
415+ raw[4 * k] = Lo(w.x);
416+ raw[4 * k + 1] = Hi(w.x);
417+ raw[4 * k + 2] = Lo(w.y);
418+ raw[4 * k + 3] = Hi(w.y);
419+ }
420+#pragma unroll
421+ for (int c = 0; c < kShCoeffs; ++c) {
422+ coeffs[c] = {raw[3 * c], raw[3 * c + 1], raw[3 * c + 2]};
423+ }
424+ }
425+ GS_D static void StoreRow(ShBf16* row, const float3 dsh[kShCoeffs]) {
426+ float raw[3 * kShCoeffs];
427+#pragma unroll
428+ for (int c = 0; c < kShCoeffs; ++c) {
429+ raw[3 * c] = dsh[c].x;
430+ raw[3 * c + 1] = dsh[c].y;
431+ raw[3 * c + 2] = dsh[c].z;
432+ }
433+ uint2* p = reinterpret_cast<uint2*>(row);
434+#pragma unroll
435+ for (int k = 0; k < 12; ++k) {
436+ p[k] = {Pack(raw[4 * k], raw[4 * k + 1]),
437+ Pack(raw[4 * k + 2], raw[4 * k + 3])};
438+ }
439+ }
440+};
441+
442+template <typename ShT>
443+GS_D const ShT* ShRow(const void* sh, int i) {
444+ return static_cast<const ShT*>(sh) + static_cast<size_t>(i) * 3 * kShCoeffs;
445+}
446+template <typename ShT>
447+GS_D ShT* ShRow(void* sh, int i) {
448+ return static_cast<ShT*>(sh) + static_cast<size_t>(i) * 3 * kShCoeffs;
449+}
450+
451+// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
452+// Spherical harmonics (degree 3, Inria sign convention).
453+
454+namespace sh {
455+inline constexpr float kC0 = 0.28209479177387814f;
456+inline constexpr float kC1 = 0.4886025119029199f;
457+inline constexpr float kC2[5] = {1.0925484305920792f, -1.0925484305920792f,
458+ 0.31539156525252005f, -1.0925484305920792f,
459+ 0.5462742152960396f};
460+inline constexpr float kC3[7] = {-0.5900435899266435f, 2.890611442640554f,
461+ -0.4570457994644658f, 0.3731763325901154f,
462+ -0.4570457994644658f, 1.445305721320277f,
463+ -0.5900435899266435f};
464+
465+// Basis values for a unit direction.
466+GS_D void Basis(float3 d, float b[kShCoeffs]) {
467+ const float x = d.x, y = d.y, z = d.z;
468+ const float xx = x * x, yy = y * y, zz = z * z;
469+ b[0] = kC0;
470+ b[1] = -kC1 * y;
471+ b[2] = kC1 * z;
472+ b[3] = -kC1 * x;
473+ b[4] = kC2[0] * x * y;
474+ b[5] = kC2[1] * y * z;
475+ b[6] = kC2[2] * (2.0f * zz - xx - yy);
476+ b[7] = kC2[3] * x * z;
477+ b[8] = kC2[4] * (xx - yy);
478+ b[9] = kC3[0] * y * (3.0f * xx - yy);
479+ b[10] = kC3[1] * x * y * z;
480+ b[11] = kC3[2] * y * (4.0f * zz - xx - yy);
481+ b[12] = kC3[3] * z * (2.0f * zz - 3.0f * xx - 3.0f * yy);
482+ b[13] = kC3[4] * x * (4.0f * zz - xx - yy);
483+ b[14] = kC3[5] * z * (xx - yy);
484+ b[15] = kC3[6] * x * (xx - 3.0f * yy);
485+}
486+
487+// Partial derivatives of every basis function w.r.t. (x, y, z) of the unit
488+// direction (treated as free coordinates).
489+GS_D void BasisGrad(float3 d, float3 g[kShCoeffs]) {
490+ const float x = d.x, y = d.y, z = d.z;
491+ const float xx = x * x, yy = y * y, zz = z * z;
492+ g[0] = {0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
493+ g[1] = {0.0f, -kC1, 0.0f};
494+ g[2] = {0.0f, 0.0f, kC1};
495+ g[3] = {-kC1, 0.0f, 0.0f};
496+ g[4] = kC2[0] * float3{y, x, 0.0f};
497+ g[5] = kC2[1] * float3{0.0f, z, y};
498+ g[6] = kC2[2] * float3{-2.0f * x, -2.0f * y, 4.0f * z};
499+ g[7] = kC2[3] * float3{z, 0.0f, x};
500+ g[8] = kC2[4] * float3{2.0f * x, -2.0f * y, 0.0f};
501+ g[9] = kC3[0] * float3{6.0f * x * y, 3.0f * (xx - yy), 0.0f};
502+ g[10] = kC3[1] * float3{y * z, x * z, x * y};
503+ g[11] =
504+ kC3[2] * float3{-2.0f * x * y, 4.0f * zz - xx - 3.0f * yy, 8.0f * y * z};
505+ g[12] = kC3[3] * float3{-6.0f * x * z, -6.0f * y * z,
506+ 6.0f * zz - 3.0f * xx - 3.0f * yy};
507+ g[13] =
508+ kC3[4] * float3{4.0f * zz - 3.0f * xx - yy, -2.0f * x * y, 8.0f * x * z};
509+ g[14] = kC3[5] * float3{2.0f * x * z, -2.0f * y * z, xx - yy};
510+ g[15] = kC3[6] * float3{3.0f * (xx - yy), -6.0f * x * y, 0.0f};
511+}
512+
513+// Pre-clamp color 0.5 + sum_k b_k sh_k, loading the full 16-basis SH row.
514+template <typename ShT>
515+GS_D float3 EvalRow(const ShT* __restrict__ sh_row, const float b[kShCoeffs]) {
516+ float3 coeffs[kShCoeffs];
517+ ShIo<ShT>::LoadRow(sh_row, coeffs);
518+ float3 c = {0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f};
519+#pragma unroll
520+ for (int k = 0; k < kShCoeffs; ++k) {
521+ c += b[k] * coeffs[k];
522+ }
523+ return c;
524+}
525+} // namespace sh

527+// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
528+// Covariance helpers.
529+
530+// Standard rotation matrix of the (unnormalized) quaternion (w, x, y, z).
531+GS_D Mat3 QuatToRotation(float4 q) {
532+ const float w = q.x, x = q.y, y = q.z, z = q.w;
533+ Mat3 r;
534+ r.m[0][0] = 1.0f - 2.0f * (y * y + z * z);
535+ r.m[0][1] = 2.0f * (x * y - w * z);
536+ r.m[0][2] = 2.0f * (x * z + w * y);
537+ r.m[1][0] = 2.0f * (x * y + w * z);
538+ r.m[1][1] = 1.0f - 2.0f * (x * x + z * z);
539+ r.m[1][2] = 2.0f * (y * z - w * x);
540+ r.m[2][0] = 2.0f * (x * z - w * y);
541+ r.m[2][1] = 2.0f * (y * z + w * x);
542+ r.m[2][2] = 1.0f - 2.0f * (x * x + y * y);
543+ return r;
544+}
545+
546+// Symmetric 3x3 matrix.
547+struct Sym3 {
548+ float xx, xy, xz, yy, yz, zz;
549+ GS_D float3 Mul(float3 v) const {
550+ return {xx * v.x + xy * v.y + xz * v.z, xy * v.x + yy * v.y + yz * v.z,
551+ xz * v.x + yz * v.y + zz * v.z};
552+ }
553+};
554+
555+// Sigma = A A^T with A = R diag(s).
556+GS_D Sym3 Covariance3D(const Mat3& r, float3 s) {
557+ Mat3 a;
558+ const float sv[3] = {s.x, s.y, s.z};
559+#pragma unroll
560+ for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
561+#pragma unroll
562+ for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) a.m[i][j] = r.m[i][j] * sv[j];
563+ return {dot(a.row(0), a.row(0)), dot(a.row(0), a.row(1)),
564+ dot(a.row(0), a.row(2)), dot(a.row(1), a.row(1)),
565+ dot(a.row(1), a.row(2)), dot(a.row(2), a.row(2))};
566+}
567+
568+// Intermediate values of the projection shared by forward and VJP.
569+struct ProjectionState {
570+ float3 t; // View-space mean.
571+ float tx_c, ty_c; // Clamped x, y used by the Jacobian.
572+ bool x_clamped, y_clamped;
573+ float3 m0, m1; // Rows of M = J W (2x3).
574+ Sym3 sigma; // World-space 3D covariance.
575+ float a, b, c; // Dilated 2D covariance.
576+};
577+
578+// Computes 2D covariance given view-space mean `t` (with t.z > kNearPlane).
579+GS_D void ProjectCovarianceFromView(const Camera& cam, float3 t, float3 scale,
580+ float4 quat, ProjectionState& st) {
581+ st.t = t;
582+ const float tz = t.z;
583+ const float limx = kFovClamp * cam.TanHalfFovX();
584+ const float limy = kFovClamp * cam.TanHalfFovY();
585+ const float txtz = t.x / tz, tytz = t.y / tz;
586+ st.x_clamped = txtz < -limx || txtz > limx;
587+ st.y_clamped = tytz < -limy || tytz > limy;
588+ st.tx_c = fminf(limx, fmaxf(-limx, txtz)) * tz;
589+ st.ty_c = fminf(limy, fmaxf(-limy, tytz)) * tz;
590+ const float j00 = cam.fx / tz, j02 = -cam.fx * st.tx_c / (tz * tz);
591+ const float j11 = cam.fy / tz, j12 = -cam.fy * st.ty_c / (tz * tz);
592+ const Mat3& w = cam.rotation;
593+ st.m0 = j00 * w.row(0) + j02 * w.row(2);
594+ st.m1 = j11 * w.row(1) + j12 * w.row(2);
595+ st.sigma = Covariance3D(QuatToRotation(quat), scale);
596+ const float3 s0 = st.sigma.Mul(st.m0), s1 = st.sigma.Mul(st.m1);
597+ st.a = dot(st.m0, s0) + kLowPass;
598+ st.b = dot(st.m0, s1);
599+ st.c = dot(st.m1, s1) + kLowPass;
600+}
601+
602+// Computes everything up to the 2D covariance. Returns false if culled by the
603+// near plane.
604+GS_D bool ProjectCovariance(const Camera& cam, float3 mean, float3 scale,
605+ float4 quat, ProjectionState& st) {
606+ const float3 t = cam.ToView(mean);
607+ if (t.z <= kNearPlane) return false;
608+ ProjectCovarianceFromView(cam, t, scale, quat, st);
609+ return true;
610+}
611+
612+// Integer bounding radius (pixels) of the 2D covariance, as in the reference.
613+GS_D int BoundingRadius(float a, float b, float c) {
614+ const float det = a * c - b * b;
615+ const float mid = 0.5f * (a + c);
616+ const float lambda = mid + sqrtf(fmaxf(0.1f, mid * mid - det));
617+ return static_cast<int>(ceilf(3.0f * sqrtf(lambda)));
618+}
619+
620+GS_D float2 ProjectMean(const Camera& cam, float3 t) {
621+ return {cam.fx * (t.x / t.z) + cam.cx, cam.fy * (t.y / t.z) + cam.cy};
622+}
623+
624+GS_D float3 LoadMean(const GaussianParams& p, int i) {
625+ return {p.means[3 * i], p.means[3 * i + 1], p.means[3 * i + 2]};
626+}
627+
628+// Unit direction from the camera center to `mean`, and 1 / distance.
629+GS_D float3 ViewDir(const Camera& cam, float3 mean, float& inv_len) {
630+ const float3 v = mean - cam.position;
631+ inv_len = rsqrtf(dot(v, v));
632+ return inv_len * v;
633+}
634+
635+// Gradient of the loss w.r.t. one splat's screen-space quantities.
636+struct ProjectionGrad {
637+ float2 xy;
638+ float3 conic; // w.r.t. the scalars (a, b, c) of `Projection::conic`.
639+ float opacity;
640+ float3 rgb;
641+};
642+
643+// Image geometry passed by value to every kernel.
644+struct Frame {
645+ const float* camera; // Device pointer to the packed camera.
646+ int width, height;
647+ TileGrid grid;
648+ GS_D Camera LoadCamera() const { return Camera::Load(camera, width, height); }
649+};

651+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
652+// Per-Gaussian kernels run one thread per Gaussian.
653+
654+inline constexpr int kGaussianThreads = 128;
655+
656+inline int GaussianBlocks(int64_t n) {
657+ return static_cast<int>((n + kGaussianThreads - 1) / kGaussianThreads);
658+}
659+
660+// Base-2 exponent scale: power2 = kPower2Scale * q = (-log2(e)/2) * q.
661+inline constexpr float kPower2Scale = -0.72134752044448170f; // -log2(e)/2
662+inline constexpr float kInvPower2Scale = 1.0f / kPower2Scale;
663+
664+GS_HD float3 Power2Conic(float a, float b, float c) {
665+ return {kPower2Scale * a, 2.0f * kPower2Scale * b, kPower2Scale * c};
666+}
667+
668+GS_D float Exp2Approx(float x) {
669+ float y;
670+ asm("ex2.approx.ftz.f32 %0, %1;" : "=f"(y) : "f"(x));
671+ return y;
672+}
673+
674+// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
675+// Rasterization. One block per 16x16 tile, one pixel per thread, arranged into
676+// eight 8x4 sub-tile warps (`RasterLayout<1>`). Splats are staged through
677+// shared memory in batches of 256 with an 8-bit per-warp sub-tile mask.
678+
679+template <int kRows>
680+struct RasterLayout {
681+ static_assert(kRows == 1 || kRows == 2 || kRows == 4);
682+ static constexpr int kThreads = kTilePixels / kRows;
683+ static constexpr int kWarps = kThreads / 32;
684+ static constexpr int kWarpWidth = kRows == 4 ? kTileSize : 8;
685+ static constexpr int kWarpRows = (32 / kWarpWidth) * kRows;
686+ static constexpr int kWarpsX = kTileSize / kWarpWidth;
687+ static_assert(kWarpsX * (kTileSize / kWarpRows) == kWarps);
688+
689+ GS_HD static constexpr int WarpX(int w) { return (w % kWarpsX) * kWarpWidth; }
690+ GS_HD static constexpr int WarpY(int w) { return (w / kWarpsX) * kWarpRows; }
691+};
692+
693+struct RasterPixels {
694+ int x, y0;
695+ template <int kRows>
696+ GS_D static RasterPixels For(int tid) {
697+ using L = RasterLayout<kRows>;
698+ const int warp = tid / 32, lane = tid % 32;
699+ return {static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * kTileSize + L::WarpX(warp) +
700+ lane % L::kWarpWidth,
701+ static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * kTileSize + L::WarpY(warp) +
702+ (lane / L::kWarpWidth) * kRows};
703+ }
704+};
705+
706+// Bit w is set if splat (p0, p1) can reach alpha >= 1/255 somewhere in the
707+// pixel region of warp w of this block's tile.
708+template <int kRows>
709+GS_D uint32_t WarpMask(float4 p0, float4 p1) {
710+ using L = RasterLayout<kRows>;
711+ constexpr int kWarpsY = L::kWarps / L::kWarpsX;
712+ float limit = p1.z;
713+ if (limit <= 0.0f && !AlphaLimit(p1.y, limit)) return 0;
714+ const float a = p0.z, b = p0.w, c = p1.x;
715+ const float det = a * c - b * b;
716+ if (!(det > 0.0f && a > 0.0f && c > 0.0f)) return 0;
717+ const float l_over_det = limit / det;
718+ const float rx = sqrtf(c * l_over_det);
719+ const float ry = sqrtf(a * l_over_det);
720+ const float2 xy = {p0.x, p0.y};
721+ const int x0 = static_cast<int>(ceilf(xy.x - rx - kSpanPadPx));
722+ const int x1 = static_cast<int>(floorf(xy.x + rx + kSpanPadPx));
723+ const int y0 = static_cast<int>(ceilf(xy.y - ry - kSpanPadPx));
724+ const int y1 = static_cast<int>(floorf(xy.y + ry + kSpanPadPx));
725+ if (x0 > x1 || y0 > y1) return 0;
726+ const int tx = blockIdx.x * kTileSize, ty = blockIdx.y * kTileSize;
727+ uint32_t mx = 0u;
728+#pragma unroll
729+ for (int wx = 0; wx < L::kWarpsX; ++wx) {
730+ const int wx0 = tx + wx * L::kWarpWidth;
731+ if (x0 <= wx0 + L::kWarpWidth - 1 && x1 >= wx0) mx |= (1u << wx);
732+ }
733+ if (mx == 0u) return 0;
734+ uint32_t my = 0u;
735+#pragma unroll
736+ for (int wy = 0; wy < kWarpsY; ++wy) {
737+ const int wy0 = ty + wy * L::kWarpRows;
738+ if (y0 <= wy0 + L::kWarpRows - 1 && y1 >= wy0) my |= (1u << wy);
739+ }
740+ if (my == 0u) return 0;
741+ if ((mx & (mx - 1u)) == 0u || (my & (my - 1u)) == 0u) {
742+ uint32_t mask = 0u;
743+#pragma unroll
744+ for (int wy = 0; wy < kWarpsY; ++wy) {
745+ if (!((my >> wy) & 1u)) continue;
746+#pragma unroll
747+ for (int wx = 0; wx < L::kWarpsX; ++wx) {
748+ if ((mx >> wx) & 1u) mask |= (1u << (wy * L::kWarpsX + wx));
749+ }
750+ }
751+ return mask;
752+ }
753+ EllipseBounds eb;
754+ eb.a = a;
755+ eb.b = b;
756+ eb.c = c;
757+ eb.det = det;
758+ eb.inv_a = 1.0f / a;
759+ eb.a_limit = a * limit;
760+ eb.y_ext = ry;
761+ eb.dy_peak = b * sqrtf(l_over_det / c);
762+ uint32_t mask = 0u;
763+#pragma unroll
764+ for (int wy = 0; wy < kWarpsY; ++wy) {
765+ if (!((my >> wy) & 1u)) continue;
766+ const int wy0 = ty + wy * L::kWarpRows;
767+ int x0_px, x1_px;
768+ if (!eb.SpanForPixelRows(xy, wy0, wy0 + L::kWarpRows - 1, x0_px, x1_px)) {
769+ continue;
770+ }
771+#pragma unroll
772+ for (int wx = 0; wx < L::kWarpsX; ++wx) {
773+ const int wx0 = tx + wx * L::kWarpWidth;
774+ if (x0_px <= wx0 + L::kWarpWidth - 1 && x1_px >= wx0) {
775+ mask |= 1u << (wy * L::kWarpsX + wx);
776+ }
777+ }
778+ }
779+ return mask;
780+}

70// Forward version of 2D covariance matrix computation
71__device__ float4 computeCov2D(const float3& mean, float focal_x, float focal_y,
72 float tan_fovx, float tan_fovy,
73 const float* cov3D, const float* viewmatrix,
74 float kernel_size, bool mip_splatting_enabled) {
75 // The following models the steps outlined by equations 29
76 // and 31 in "EWA Splatting" (Zwicker et al., 2002).
77 // Additionally considers aspect / scaling of viewport.
78 // Transposes used to account for row-/column-major conventions.
79 float3 t = transformPoint4x3(mean, viewmatrix);
80
81 const float limx = 1.3f * tan_fovx;
82 const float limy = 1.3f * tan_fovy;
83 const float txtz = t.x / t.z;
84 const float tytz = t.y / t.z;
85 t.x = min(limx, max(-limx, txtz)) * t.z;
86 t.y = min(limy, max(-limy, tytz)) * t.z;
87
88 glm::mat3 J =
89 glm::mat3(focal_x / t.z, 0.0f, -(focal_x * t.x) / (t.z * t.z), 0.0f,
90 focal_y / t.z, -(focal_y * t.y) / (t.z * t.z), 0, 0, 0);
91
92 glm::mat3 W = glm::mat3(viewmatrix[0], viewmatrix[4], viewmatrix[8],
93 viewmatrix[1], viewmatrix[5], viewmatrix[9],
94 viewmatrix[2], viewmatrix[6], viewmatrix[10]);
95
96 glm::mat3 T = W * J;
97
98 glm::mat3 Vrk = glm::mat3(cov3D[0], cov3D[1], cov3D[2], cov3D[1], cov3D[3],
99 cov3D[4], cov3D[2], cov3D[4], cov3D[5]);
100
101 glm::mat3 cov = glm::transpose(T) * glm::transpose(Vrk) * T;
102
103 float coef;
104 if (mip_splatting_enabled) {
105 // compute the coef of alpha based on the detemintant
106 const float det_0 =
107 max(1e-6, cov[0][0] * cov[1][1] - cov[0][1] * cov[0][1]);
108 const float det_1 =
109 max(1e-6, (cov[0][0] + kernel_size) * (cov[1][1] + kernel_size) -
110 cov[0][1] * cov[0][1]);
111 coef = sqrt(det_0 / (det_1 + 1e-6) + 1e-6);
112
113 if (det_0 <= 1e-6 || det_1 <= 1e-6) {
114 coef = 0.0f;
187 if (__all_sync(warp::kFullMask, done)) {
188 warp_done = true;
189 break;
115 }190 }
116
117 cov[0][0] += kernel_size;
118 cov[1][1] += kernel_size;
119 } else {
120 // Apply low-pass filter: every Gaussian should be at least
121 // one pixel wide/high. Discard 3rd row and column.
122 cov[0][0] += 0.3f;
123 cov[1][1] += 0.3f;
124 coef = 1.0f;
125 }191 }
126 return {float(cov[0][0]), float(cov[0][1]), float(cov[1][1]), coef};
192 warp_done = __all_sync(warp::kFullMask, done);
127}193 }

129// Forward method for converting scale and rotation properties of each
130// Gaussian to a 3D covariance matrix in world space. Also takes care
131// of quaternion normalization.
132__device__ void computeCov3D(const glm::vec3 scale, float mod,
133 const glm::vec4 rot, float* cov3D) {
134 // Create scaling matrix
135 glm::mat3 S = glm::mat3(1.0f);
136 S[0][0] = mod * scale.x;
137 S[1][1] = mod * scale.y;
138 S[2][2] = mod * scale.z;
139
140 // Normalize quaternion to get valid rotation
141 glm::vec4 q = rot; // / glm::length(rot);
142 float r = q.x;
143 float x = q.y;
144 float y = q.z;
145 float z = q.w;
146
147 // Compute rotation matrix from quaternion
148 glm::mat3 R = glm::mat3(1.f - 2.f * (y * y + z * z), 2.f * (x * y - r * z),
149 2.f * (x * z + r * y), 2.f * (x * y + r * z),
150 1.f - 2.f * (x * x + z * z), 2.f * (y * z - r * x),
151 2.f * (x * z - r * y), 2.f * (y * z + r * x),
152 1.f - 2.f * (x * x + y * y));
153
154 glm::mat3 M = S * R;
155
156 // Compute 3D world covariance matrix Sigma
157 glm::mat3 Sigma = glm::transpose(M) * M;
158
159 // Covariance is symmetric, only store upper right
160 cov3D[0] = Sigma[0][0];
161 cov3D[1] = Sigma[0][1];
162 cov3D[2] = Sigma[0][2];
163 cov3D[3] = Sigma[1][1];
164 cov3D[4] = Sigma[1][2];
165 cov3D[5] = Sigma[2][2];
166}194 }

168// Perform initial steps for each Gaussian prior to rasterization.
169template <int C>
170__global__ void preprocessCUDA(
171 int P, int D, int M, const float* orig_points, const glm::vec3* scales,
172 const float scale_modifier, const glm::vec4* rotations,
173 const float* opacities, const float* shs, bool* clamped,
174 const float* cov3D_precomp, const float* colors_precomp,
175 const float* viewmatrix, const float* projmatrix, const glm::vec3* cam_pos,
176 const int W, int H, const float tan_fovx, float tan_fovy,
177 const float focal_x, float focal_y, const float low_pass_2d_kernel_size,
178 const bool mip_splatting_enabled, int* radii, float2* points_xy_image,
179 float* depths, float* cov3Ds, float* rgb, float4* conic_opacity,
180 const dim3 grid, uint32_t* tiles_touched, bool prefiltered, int2* rects,
181 float3 boxmin, float3 boxmax) {
182 auto idx = cg::this_grid().thread_rank();
183 if (idx >= P) return;
184
185 // Initialize radius and touched tiles to 0. If this isn't changed,
186 // this Gaussian will not be processed further.
187 radii[idx] = 0;
188 tiles_touched[idx] = 0;
189
190 // Perform near culling, quit if outside.
191 float3 p_view;
192 if (!in_frustum(idx, orig_points, viewmatrix, projmatrix, prefiltered,
193 p_view))
194 return;
195
196 // Transform point by projecting
197 float3 p_orig = {orig_points[3 * idx], orig_points[3 * idx + 1],
198 orig_points[3 * idx + 2]};
199
200 if (p_orig.x < boxmin.x || p_orig.y < boxmin.y || p_orig.z < boxmin.z ||
201 p_orig.x > boxmax.x || p_orig.y > boxmax.y || p_orig.z > boxmax.z)
202 return;
203
204 float4 p_hom = transformPoint4x4(p_orig, projmatrix);
205 float p_w = 1.0f / (p_hom.w + 0.0000001f);
206 float3 p_proj = {p_hom.x * p_w, p_hom.y * p_w, p_hom.z * p_w};
207
208 // If 3D covariance matrix is precomputed, use it, otherwise compute
209 // from scaling and rotation parameters.
210 const float* cov3D;
211 if (cov3D_precomp != nullptr) {
212 cov3D = cov3D_precomp + idx * 6;
213 } else {
214 computeCov3D(scales[idx], scale_modifier, rotations[idx], cov3Ds + idx * 6);
215 cov3D = cov3Ds + idx * 6;
216 }195 }
217
218 // Compute 2D screen-space covariance matrix
219 float4 cov =
220 computeCov2D(p_orig, focal_x, focal_y, tan_fovx, tan_fovy, cov3D,
221 viewmatrix, low_pass_2d_kernel_size, mip_splatting_enabled);
222
223 // Invert covariance (EWA algorithm)
224 float det = (cov.x * cov.z - cov.y * cov.y);
225 if (det == 0.0f) return;
226 float det_inv = 1.f / det;
227 float3 conic = {cov.z * det_inv, -cov.y * det_inv, cov.x * det_inv};
228
229 // Compute extent in screen space (by finding eigenvalues of
230 // 2D covariance matrix). Use extent to compute a bounding rectangle
231 // of screen-space tiles that this Gaussian overlaps with. Quit if
232 // rectangle covers 0 tiles.
233
234 float mid = 0.5f * (cov.x + cov.z);
235 float lambda1 = mid + sqrt(max(0.1f, mid * mid - det));
236 float lambda2 = mid - sqrt(max(0.1f, mid * mid - det));
237 float my_radius = ceil(3.f * sqrt(max(lambda1, lambda2)));
238 float2 point_image = {ndc2Pix(p_proj.x, W), ndc2Pix(p_proj.y, H)};
239 uint2 rect_min, rect_max;
240
241 if (rects == nullptr) // More conservative
242 {
243 getRect(point_image, my_radius, rect_min, rect_max, grid);
244 } else // Slightly more aggressive, might need a math cleanup
245 {
196 if (px.x < frame.width && px.y0 < frame.height) {
197 const int pixels = frame.width * frame.height;
246 const int2 my_rect = {(int)ceil(3.f * sqrt(cov.x)),198 const int p = px.y0 * frame.width + px.x;
247 (int)ceil(3.f * sqrt(cov.z))};
248 rects[idx] = my_rect;
249 getRect(point_image, my_rect, rect_min, rect_max, grid);
250 }
251
252 if ((rect_max.x - rect_min.x) * (rect_max.y - rect_min.y) == 0) return;
253
254 // If colors have been precomputed, use them, otherwise convert
255 // spherical harmonics coefficients to RGB color.
256 if (colors_precomp == nullptr) {
257 glm::vec3 result = computeColorFromSH(idx, D, M, (glm::vec3*)orig_points,
258 *cam_pos, shs, clamped);
259 rgb[idx * C + 0] = result.x;199 image[0 * pixels + p] = r;
260 rgb[idx * C + 1] = result.y;200 image[1 * pixels + p] = g;
261 rgb[idx * C + 2] = result.z;201 image[2 * pixels + p] = b;
262 }
263
264 // Store some useful helper data for the next steps.
265 depths[idx] = p_view.z;
266 radii[idx] = my_radius;
267 points_xy_image[idx] = point_image;
268 // Inverse 2D covariance and opacity neatly pack into one float4
269 conic_opacity[idx] = {conic.x, conic.y, conic.z, opacities[idx] * cov.w};
270 tiles_touched[idx] = (rect_max.y - rect_min.y) * (rect_max.x - rect_min.x);
271}

273// Main rasterization method. Collaboratively works on one tile per
274// block, each thread treats one pixel. Alternates between fetching
275// and rasterizing data.
276template <uint32_t CHANNELS>
277__global__ void __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_X* BLOCK_Y)
278 renderCUDA(const uint2* __restrict__ ranges,
279 const uint32_t* __restrict__ point_list, int W, int H,
280 const float2* __restrict__ points_xy_image,
281 const float* __restrict__ features,
282 const float4* __restrict__ conic_opacity,
283 float* __restrict__ final_T, uint32_t* __restrict__ n_contrib,
284 const float* __restrict__ bg_color,
285 float* __restrict__ out_color) {
286 // Identify current tile and associated min/max pixel range.
287 auto block = cg::this_thread_block();
288 uint32_t horizontal_blocks = (W + BLOCK_X - 1) / BLOCK_X;
289 uint2 pix_min = {block.group_index().x * BLOCK_X,
290 block.group_index().y * BLOCK_Y};
291 uint2 pix_max = {min(pix_min.x + BLOCK_X, W), min(pix_min.y + BLOCK_Y, H)};
292 uint2 pix = {pix_min.x + block.thread_index().x,
293 pix_min.y + block.thread_index().y};
294 uint32_t pix_id = W * pix.y + pix.x;
295 float2 pixf = {(float)pix.x, (float)pix.y};
296
297 // Check if this thread is associated with a valid pixel or outside.
298 bool inside = pix.x < W && pix.y < H;
299 // Done threads can help with fetching, but don't rasterize
300 bool done = !inside;
301
302 // Load start/end range of IDs to process in bit sorted list.
303 uint2 range =
304 ranges[block.group_index().y * horizontal_blocks + block.group_index().x];
305 const int rounds = ((range.y - range.x + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE);
306 int toDo = range.y - range.x;
307
308 // Allocate storage for batches of collectively fetched data.
309 __shared__ int collected_id[BLOCK_SIZE];
310 __shared__ float2 collected_xy[BLOCK_SIZE];
311 __shared__ float4 collected_conic_opacity[BLOCK_SIZE];
312
313 // Initialize helper variables
314 float T = 1.0f;202 final_t[p] = t;
315 uint32_t contributor = 0;203 n_contrib[p] = last;
316 uint32_t last_contributor = 0;
317 float C[CHANNELS] = {0};
318
319 // Iterate over batches until all done or range is complete
320 for (int i = 0; i < rounds; i++, toDo -= BLOCK_SIZE) {
321 // End if entire block votes that it is done rasterizing
322 int num_done = __syncthreads_count(done);
323 if (num_done == BLOCK_SIZE) break;
324
325 // Collectively fetch per-Gaussian data from global to shared
326 int progress = i * BLOCK_SIZE + block.thread_rank();
327 if (range.x + progress < range.y) {
328 int coll_id = point_list[range.x + progress];
329 collected_id[block.thread_rank()] = coll_id;
330 collected_xy[block.thread_rank()] = points_xy_image[coll_id];
331 collected_conic_opacity[block.thread_rank()] = conic_opacity[coll_id];
332 }
333 block.sync();
334
335 // Iterate over current batch
336 for (int j = 0; !done && j < min(BLOCK_SIZE, toDo); j++) {
337 // Keep track of current position in range
338 contributor++;
339
340 // Resample using conic matrix (cf. "Surface
341 // Splatting" by Zwicker et al., 2001)
342 float2 xy = collected_xy[j];
343 float2 d = {xy.x - pixf.x, xy.y - pixf.y};
344 float4 con_o = collected_conic_opacity[j];
345 float power = -0.5f * (con_o.x * d.x * d.x + con_o.z * d.y * d.y) -
346 con_o.y * d.x * d.y;
347 if (power > 0.0f) continue;
348
349 // Eq. (2) from 3D Gaussian splatting paper.
350 // Obtain alpha by multiplying with Gaussian opacity
351 // and its exponential falloff from mean.
352 // Avoid numerical instabilities (see paper appendix).
353 float alpha = min(0.99f, con_o.w * exp(power));
354 if (alpha < 1.0f / 255.0f) continue;
355 float test_T = T * (1 - alpha);
356 if (test_T < 0.0001f) {
357 done = true;
358 continue;
359 }
360
361 // Eq. (3) from 3D Gaussian splatting paper.
362 for (int ch = 0; ch < CHANNELS; ch++)
363 C[ch] += features[collected_id[j] * CHANNELS + ch] * alpha * T;
364
365 T = test_T;
366
367 // Keep track of last range entry to update this
368 // pixel.
369 last_contributor = contributor;
370 }204 }
371 }205}
372206
373 // All threads that treat valid pixel write out their final
374 // rendering data to the frame and auxiliary buffers.
375 if (inside) {
376 final_T[pix_id] = T;
377 n_contrib[pix_id] = last_contributor;
378 for (int ch = 0; ch < CHANNELS; ch++)
379 out_color[ch * H * W + pix_id] = C[ch] + T * bg_color[ch];
380 }
381}

142// Backward version of INVERSE 2D covariance matrix computation
143// (due to length launched as separate kernel before other

145__global__ void computeCov2DCUDA(
146 int P, const float3* means, const int* radii, const float* cov3Ds,
147 const float4* __restrict__ conic_opacity, const float h_x, float h_y,
148 const float tan_fovx, float tan_fovy, const float low_pass_2d_kernel_size,

158 // Fetch gradients, recompute 2D covariance and relevant
159 // intermediate forward results needed in the backward.

161 float3 dL_dconic = {dL_dconics[4 * idx], dL_dconics[4 * idx + 1],
162 dL_dconics[4 * idx + 3]};
163 float3 t = transformPoint4x3(mean, view_matrix);
164
165 const float limx = 1.3f * tan_fovx;
166 const float limy = 1.3f * tan_fovy;
167 const float txtz = t.x / t.z;
168 const float tytz = t.y / t.z;
169 t.x = min(limx, max(-limx, txtz)) * t.z;
170 t.y = min(limy, max(-limy, tytz)) * t.z;
171
172 const float x_grad_mul = txtz < -limx || txtz > limx ? 0 : 1;
173 const float y_grad_mul = tytz < -limy || tytz > limy ? 0 : 1;

175 glm::mat3 J = glm::mat3(h_x / t.z, 0.0f, -(h_x * t.x) / (t.z * t.z), 0.0f,
176 h_y / t.z, -(h_y * t.y) / (t.z * t.z), 0, 0, 0);

178 glm::mat3 W = glm::mat3(view_matrix[0], view_matrix[4], view_matrix[8],
179 view_matrix[1], view_matrix[5], view_matrix[9],
180 view_matrix[2], view_matrix[6], view_matrix[10]);
181
182 glm::mat3 Vrk = glm::mat3(cov3D[0], cov3D[1], cov3D[2], cov3D[1], cov3D[3],
183 cov3D[4], cov3D[2], cov3D[4], cov3D[5]);

185 glm::mat3 T = W * J;
186
187 glm::mat3 cov2D = glm::transpose(T) * glm::transpose(Vrk) * T;
188
189 float kernel_size_to_use;
190 if (mip_splatting_enabled)
191 kernel_size_to_use = low_pass_2d_kernel_size;
192 else
193 kernel_size_to_use = 0.3f;

196 float b = cov2D[0][1];
197 float c = cov2D[1][1] += kernel_size_to_use;

200 float dL_da = 0, dL_db = 0, dL_dc = 0;
201 float denom2inv = 1.0f / ((denom * denom) + 0.0000001f);

204 // Gradients of loss w.r.t. entries of 2D covariance matrix,
205 // given gradients of loss w.r.t. conic matrix (inverse covariance matrix).
206 // e.g., dL / da = dL / d_conic_a * d_conic_a / d_a
207 dL_da = denom2inv * (-c * c * dL_dconic.x + 2 * b * c * dL_dconic.y +
208 (denom - a * c) * dL_dconic.z);
209 dL_dc = denom2inv * (-a * a * dL_dconic.z + 2 * a * b * dL_dconic.y +
210 (denom - a * c) * dL_dconic.x);
211 dL_db = denom2inv * 2 *
212 (b * c * dL_dconic.x - (denom + 2 * b * b) * dL_dconic.y +
213 a * b * dL_dconic.z);
214
215 if (mip_splatting_enabled) {
216 const float det_0 =
217 max(1e-6, cov2D[0][0] * cov2D[1][1] - cov2D[0][1] * cov2D[0][1]);
218 const float det_1 = max(1e-6, (cov2D[0][0] + kernel_size_to_use) *
219 (cov2D[1][1] + kernel_size_to_use) -
220 cov2D[0][1] * cov2D[0][1]);
221 // sqrt here
222 const float coef = sqrt(det_0 / (det_1 + 1e-6) + 1e-6);
223
224 // update the gradient of alpha and save the gradient of dalpha_dcoef
225 // we need opacity as input
226 // new_opacity = coef * opacity
227 // if we know the new opacity, we can derive original opacity and then
228 // dalpha_dcoef = dopacity * opacity
229 const float opacity = conic_opacity[idx].w / (coef + 1e-6);
230 const float dL_dcoef = dL_dopacity[idx] * opacity;
231 const float dL_dsqrtcoef = dL_dcoef * 0.5 * 1. / (coef + 1e-6);
232 const float dL_ddet0 = dL_dsqrtcoef / (det_1 + 1e-6);
233 const float dL_ddet1 =
234 dL_dsqrtcoef * det_0 * (-1.f / (det_1 * det_1 + 1e-6));
235 // TODO gradient is zero if det_0 or det_1 < 0
236 const float dcoef_da = dL_ddet0 * cov2D[1][1] +
237 dL_ddet1 * (cov2D[1][1] + kernel_size_to_use);
238 const float dcoef_db =
239 dL_ddet0 * (-2. * cov2D[0][1]) + dL_ddet1 * (-2. * cov2D[0][1]);
240 const float dcoef_dc = dL_ddet0 * cov2D[0][0] +
241 dL_ddet1 * (cov2D[0][0] + kernel_size_to_use);
242
243 if (det_0 <= 1e-6 || det_1 <= 1e-6) {
244 dL_dopacity[idx] = 0;
245 } else {
246 // Gradiends of alpha respect to conv due to low pass filter
247 dL_da += dcoef_da;
248 dL_dc += dcoef_dc;
249 dL_db += dcoef_db;
250
251 // update dL_dopacity
252 dL_dopacity[idx] = dL_dopacity[idx] * coef;
309 }
310 }
311 }
312 }
313 __syncthreads();
253 }314 }
254 }315}

260 (T[0][0] * T[0][0] * dL_da + T[0][0] * T[1][0] * dL_db +
261 T[1][0] * T[1][0] * dL_dc);
262 dL_dcov[6 * idx + 3] =
263 (T[0][1] * T[0][1] * dL_da + T[0][1] * T[1][1] * dL_db +

265 dL_dcov[6 * idx + 5] =

270 // given gradients w.r.t. 2D covariance matrix (off-diagonal).
271 // Off-diagonal elements appear twice --> double the gradient.
272 // cov2D = transpose(T) * transpose(Vrk) * T;
273 dL_dcov[6 * idx + 1] = 2 * T[0][0] * T[0][1] * dL_da +
274 (T[0][0] * T[1][1] + T[0][1] * T[1][0]) * dL_db +
275 2 * T[1][0] * T[1][1] * dL_dc;
276 dL_dcov[6 * idx + 2] = 2 * T[0][0] * T[0][2] * dL_da +
277 (T[0][0] * T[1][2] + T[0][2] * T[1][0]) * dL_db +
278 2 * T[1][0] * T[1][2] * dL_dc;
279 dL_dcov[6 * idx + 4] = 2 * T[0][2] * T[0][1] * dL_da +
280 (T[0][1] * T[1][2] + T[0][2] * T[1][1]) * dL_db +
281 2 * T[1][1] * T[1][2] * dL_dc;

322template <typename ShT>
323__global__ void __launch_bounds__(kGaussianThreads)
324 PreprocessBackwardKernel(GaussianParams params, Frame frame,
325 const Splat* __restrict__ splats,
326 const float* __restrict__ splat_grads,
327 GaussianGrads grads) {
328 const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
329 if (i >= params.n || splats[i].radius() == 0) return;
330 float g[kSplatGradFloats];
331 bool nonzero = false;
332#pragma unroll
283 for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) dL_dcov[6 * idx + i] = 0;333 for (int q = 0; q < kSplatGradFloats; ++q) {
334 g[q] = __ldg(&splat_grads[kSplatGradFloats * i + q]);
335 nonzero = nonzero || g[q] != 0.0f;
336 }
337 if (!nonzero) return;
338 ProjectionGrad pg;
339 pg.xy = {g[0], g[1]};
340 pg.conic = {g[2], g[3], g[4]};
341 pg.opacity = g[5];
342 pg.rgb = {g[6], g[7], g[8]};

344 float4 dquat;
345 ProjectVjp(params, frame.LoadCamera(), i, ShRow<ShT>(params.sh, i),
346 ShRow<ShT>(grads.sh, i), pg, dmean, dscale, dquat);
347 grads.means[3 * i] = dmean.x;
348 grads.means[3 * i + 1] = dmean.y;
349 grads.means[3 * i + 2] = dmean.z;
350 grads.scales[3 * i] = dscale.x;
351 grads.scales[3 * i + 1] = dscale.y;
352 grads.scales[3 * i + 2] = dscale.z;
353 reinterpret_cast<float4*>(grads.quats)[i] = dquat;
354 grads.opacities[i] = g[5];

286 // Gradients of loss w.r.t. upper 2x3 portion of intermediate matrix T
287 // cov2D = transpose(T) * transpose(Vrk) * T;
288 float dL_dT00 =
289 2 * (T[0][0] * Vrk[0][0] + T[0][1] * Vrk[0][1] + T[0][2] * Vrk[0][2]) *
290 dL_da +
291 (T[1][0] * Vrk[0][0] + T[1][1] * Vrk[0][1] + T[1][2] * Vrk[0][2]) * dL_db;
292 float dL_dT01 =
293 2 * (T[0][0] * Vrk[1][0] + T[0][1] * Vrk[1][1] + T[0][2] * Vrk[1][2]) *
294 dL_da +
295 (T[1][0] * Vrk[1][0] + T[1][1] * Vrk[1][1] + T[1][2] * Vrk[1][2]) * dL_db;
296 float dL_dT02 =
297 2 * (T[0][0] * Vrk[2][0] + T[0][1] * Vrk[2][1] + T[0][2] * Vrk[2][2]) *
298 dL_da +
299 (T[1][0] * Vrk[2][0] + T[1][1] * Vrk[2][1] + T[1][2] * Vrk[2][2]) * dL_db;
300 float dL_dT10 =
301 2 * (T[1][0] * Vrk[0][0] + T[1][1] * Vrk[0][1] + T[1][2] * Vrk[0][2]) *
302 dL_dc +
303 (T[0][0] * Vrk[0][0] + T[0][1] * Vrk[0][1] + T[0][2] * Vrk[0][2]) * dL_db;
304 float dL_dT11 =
305 2 * (T[1][0] * Vrk[1][0] + T[1][1] * Vrk[1][1] + T[1][2] * Vrk[1][2]) *
306 dL_dc +
307 (T[0][0] * Vrk[1][0] + T[0][1] * Vrk[1][1] + T[0][2] * Vrk[1][2]) * dL_db;
308 float dL_dT12 =
309 2 * (T[1][0] * Vrk[2][0] + T[1][1] * Vrk[2][1] + T[1][2] * Vrk[2][2]) *
310 dL_dc +
311 (T[0][0] * Vrk[2][0] + T[0][1] * Vrk[2][1] + T[0][2] * Vrk[2][2]) * dL_db;
312
313 // Gradients of loss w.r.t. upper 3x2 non-zero entries of Jacobian matrix
314 // T = W * J
315 float dL_dJ00 = W[0][0] * dL_dT00 + W[0][1] * dL_dT01 + W[0][2] * dL_dT02;
316 float dL_dJ02 = W[2][0] * dL_dT00 + W[2][1] * dL_dT01 + W[2][2] * dL_dT02;
317 float dL_dJ11 = W[1][0] * dL_dT10 + W[1][1] * dL_dT11 + W[1][2] * dL_dT12;
318 float dL_dJ12 = W[2][0] * dL_dT10 + W[2][1] * dL_dT11 + W[2][2] * dL_dT12;
319
320 float tz = 1.f / t.z;
321 float tz2 = tz * tz;
322 float tz3 = tz2 * tz;
323
324 // Gradients of loss w.r.t. transformed Gaussian mean t
325 float dL_dtx = x_grad_mul * -h_x * tz2 * dL_dJ02;
326 float dL_dty = y_grad_mul * -h_y * tz2 * dL_dJ12;
327 float dL_dtz = -h_x * tz2 * dL_dJ00 - h_y * tz2 * dL_dJ11 +
328 (2 * h_x * t.x) * tz3 * dL_dJ02 +
329 (2 * h_y * t.y) * tz3 * dL_dJ12;
330
331 // Account for transformation of mean to t
332 // t = transformPoint4x3(mean, view_matrix);
333 float3 dL_dmean =
334 transformVec4x3Transpose({dL_dtx, dL_dty, dL_dtz}, view_matrix);

357template <typename ShT>
358cudaError_t LaunchPreprocessBackward(const GaussianParams& params,
359 const Frame& frame, const Splat* splats,
360 const float* splat_grads,
361 const GaussianGrads& grads,
362 cudaStream_t stream) {
363 const int n = params.n;
364 // As Inria's PyTorch wrapper (`torch::zeros`): bulk-zero every parameter
336 // Gradients of loss w.r.t. Gaussian means, but only the portion365 // gradient up front; culled Gaussians then exit early in the kernel.
337 // that is caused because the mean affects the covariance matrix.
338 // Additional mean gradient is accumulated in BACKWARD::preprocess.
339 dL_dmeans[idx] = dL_dmean;
366 if (auto e = cudaMemsetAsync(grads.means, 0, sizeof(float) * 3 * n, stream);
367 e != cudaSuccess)
368 return e;
369 if (auto e = cudaMemsetAsync(grads.scales, 0, sizeof(float) * 3 * n, stream);
370 e != cudaSuccess)
371 return e;
372 if (auto e = cudaMemsetAsync(grads.quats, 0, sizeof(float) * 4 * n, stream);
373 e != cudaSuccess)
374 return e;
375 if (auto e = cudaMemsetAsync(grads.opacities, 0, sizeof(float) * n, stream);
376 e != cudaSuccess)
377 return e;
378 if (auto e =
379 cudaMemsetAsync(grads.sh, 0, sizeof(ShT) * 3 * kShCoeffs * n, stream);
380 e != cudaSuccess)
381 return e;
382 PreprocessBackwardKernel<ShT>
383 <<<GaussianBlocks(n), kGaussianThreads, 0, stream>>>(
384 params, frame, splats, splat_grads, grads);
385 return cudaSuccess;

422// Backward pass of the preprocessing steps, except
423// for the covariance computation and inversion
424// (those are handled by a previous kernel call)
425template <int C>
426__global__ void preprocessCUDA(
427 int P, int D, int M, const float3* means, const int* radii,
428 const float* shs, const bool* clamped, const glm::vec3* scales,
429 const glm::vec4* rotations, const float scale_modifier, const float* proj,
430 const glm::vec3* campos, const float3* dL_dmean2D, glm::vec3* dL_dmeans,
431 float* dL_dcolor, float* dL_dcov3D, float* dL_dsh, glm::vec3* dL_dscale,
432 glm::vec4* dL_drot) {
433 auto idx = cg::this_grid().thread_rank();
434 if (idx >= P || !(radii[idx] > 0)) return;
435
436 float3 m = means[idx];
437
438 // Taking care of gradients from the screenspace points
439 float4 m_hom = transformPoint4x4(m, proj);
440 float m_w = 1.0f / (m_hom.w + 0.0000001f);
441
442 // Compute loss gradient w.r.t. 3D means due to gradients of 2D means
443 // from rendering procedure
444 glm::vec3 dL_dmean;
445 float mul1 =
446 (proj[0] * m.x + proj[4] * m.y + proj[8] * m.z + proj[12]) * m_w * m_w;
447 float mul2 =
448 (proj[1] * m.x + proj[5] * m.y + proj[9] * m.z + proj[13]) * m_w * m_w;
449 dL_dmean.x = (proj[0] * m_w - proj[3] * mul1) * dL_dmean2D[idx].x +
450 (proj[1] * m_w - proj[3] * mul2) * dL_dmean2D[idx].y;
451 dL_dmean.y = (proj[4] * m_w - proj[7] * mul1) * dL_dmean2D[idx].x +
452 (proj[5] * m_w - proj[7] * mul2) * dL_dmean2D[idx].y;
453 dL_dmean.z = (proj[8] * m_w - proj[11] * mul1) * dL_dmean2D[idx].x +
454 (proj[9] * m_w - proj[11] * mul2) * dL_dmean2D[idx].y;
455
456 // That's the second part of the mean gradient. Previous computation
457 // of cov2D and following SH conversion also affects it.
458 dL_dmeans[idx] += dL_dmean;
459
460 // Compute gradient updates due to computing colors from SHs
461 if (shs)
462 computeColorFromSH(idx, D, M, (glm::vec3*)means, *campos, shs, clamped,
463 (glm::vec3*)dL_dcolor, (glm::vec3*)dL_dmeans,
464 (glm::vec3*)dL_dsh);
465
466 // Compute gradient updates due to computing covariance from scale/rotation
467 if (scales)
468 computeCov3D(idx, scales[idx], scale_modifier, rotations[idx], dL_dcov3D,
469 dL_dscale, dL_drot);
470}

472// Backward version of the rendering procedure.
473template <uint32_t C>
474__global__ void __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_X* BLOCK_Y) renderCUDA(
475 const uint2* __restrict__ ranges, const uint32_t* __restrict__ point_list,
476 int W, int H, const float* __restrict__ bg_color,
477 const float2* __restrict__ points_xy_image,
478 const float4* __restrict__ conic_opacity, const float* __restrict__ colors,
479 const float* __restrict__ final_Ts, const uint32_t* __restrict__ n_contrib,
480 const float* __restrict__ dL_dpixels, float3* __restrict__ dL_dmean2D,
481 float4* __restrict__ dL_dconic2D, float* __restrict__ dL_dopacity,
482 float* __restrict__ dL_dcolors) {
483 // We rasterize again. Compute necessary block info.
484 auto block = cg::this_thread_block();
485 const uint32_t horizontal_blocks = (W + BLOCK_X - 1) / BLOCK_X;
486 const uint2 pix_min = {block.group_index().x * BLOCK_X,
487 block.group_index().y * BLOCK_Y};
488 const uint2 pix_max = {min(pix_min.x + BLOCK_X, W),
489 min(pix_min.y + BLOCK_Y, H)};
490 const uint2 pix = {pix_min.x + block.thread_index().x,
491 pix_min.y + block.thread_index().y};
492 const uint32_t pix_id = W * pix.y + pix.x;
493 const float2 pixf = {(float)pix.x, (float)pix.y};
494
495 const bool inside = pix.x < W && pix.y < H;
496 const uint2 range =
497 ranges[block.group_index().y * horizontal_blocks + block.group_index().x];
498
499 const int rounds = ((range.y - range.x + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE);
500
501 bool done = !inside;
502 int toDo = range.y - range.x;
503
504 __shared__ int collected_id[BLOCK_SIZE];
505 __shared__ float2 collected_xy[BLOCK_SIZE];
506 __shared__ float4 collected_conic_opacity[BLOCK_SIZE];
507 __shared__ float collected_colors[C * BLOCK_SIZE];
508
509 // In the forward, we stored the final value for T, the
510 // product of all (1 - alpha) factors.
511 const float T_final = inside ? final_Ts[pix_id] : 0;
512 float T = T_final;
513
514 // We start from the back. The ID of the last contributing
515 // Gaussian is known from each pixel from the forward.
516 uint32_t contributor = toDo;
517 const int last_contributor = inside ? n_contrib[pix_id] : 0;
518
519 float accum_rec[C] = {0};
520 float dL_dpixel[C];
521 if (inside)
522 for (int i = 0; i < C; i++) dL_dpixel[i] = dL_dpixels[i * H * W + pix_id];
523
524 float last_alpha = 0;
525 float last_color[C] = {0};
526
527 // Gradient of pixel coordinate w.r.t. normalized
528 // screen-space viewport corrdinates (-1 to 1)
529 const float ddelx_dx = 0.5 * W;
530 const float ddely_dy = 0.5 * H;
531
532 // Traverse all Gaussians
533 for (int i = 0; i < rounds; i++, toDo -= BLOCK_SIZE) {
534 // Load auxiliary data into shared memory, start in the BACK
535 // and load them in revers order.
536 block.sync();
537 const int progress = i * BLOCK_SIZE + block.thread_rank();
538 if (range.x + progress < range.y) {
539 const int coll_id = point_list[range.y - progress - 1];
540 collected_id[block.thread_rank()] = coll_id;
541 collected_xy[block.thread_rank()] = points_xy_image[coll_id];
542 collected_conic_opacity[block.thread_rank()] = conic_opacity[coll_id];
543 for (int i = 0; i < C; i++)
544 collected_colors[i * BLOCK_SIZE + block.thread_rank()] =
545 colors[coll_id * C + i];
546 }
547 block.sync();
548
549 // Iterate over Gaussians
550 for (int j = 0; !done && j < min(BLOCK_SIZE, toDo); j++) {
551 // Keep track of current Gaussian ID. Skip, if this one
552 // is behind the last contributor for this pixel.
553 contributor--;
554 if (contributor >= last_contributor) continue;
555
556 // Compute blending values, as before.
557 const float2 xy = collected_xy[j];
558 const float2 d = {xy.x - pixf.x, xy.y - pixf.y};
559 const float4 con_o = collected_conic_opacity[j];
560 const float power = -0.5f * (con_o.x * d.x * d.x + con_o.z * d.y * d.y) -
561 con_o.y * d.x * d.y;
562 if (power > 0.0f) continue;
563
564 const float G = exp(power);
565 const float alpha = min(0.99f, con_o.w * G);
566 if (alpha < 1.0f / 255.0f) continue;
567
568 T = T / (1.f - alpha);
569 const float dchannel_dcolor = alpha * T;
570
571 // Propagate gradients to per-Gaussian colors and keep
572 // gradients w.r.t. alpha (blending factor for a Gaussian/pixel
573 // pair).
574 float dL_dalpha = 0.0f;
575 const int global_id = collected_id[j];
576 for (int ch = 0; ch < C; ch++) {
577 const float c = collected_colors[ch * BLOCK_SIZE + j];
578 // Update last color (to be used in the next iteration)
579 accum_rec[ch] =
580 last_alpha * last_color[ch] + (1.f - last_alpha) * accum_rec[ch];
581 last_color[ch] = c;
582
583 const float dL_dchannel = dL_dpixel[ch];
584 dL_dalpha += (c - accum_rec[ch]) * dL_dchannel;
585 // Update the gradients w.r.t. color of the Gaussian.
586 // Atomic, since this pixel is just one of potentially
587 // many that were affected by this Gaussian.
588 atomicAdd(&(dL_dcolors[global_id * C + ch]),
589 dchannel_dcolor * dL_dchannel);
590 }
591 dL_dalpha *= T;
592 // Update last alpha (to be used in the next iteration)
593 last_alpha = alpha;
594
595 // Account for fact that alpha also influences how much of
596 // the background color is added if nothing left to blend
597 float bg_dot_dpixel = 0;
598 for (int i = 0; i < C; i++) bg_dot_dpixel += bg_color[i] * dL_dpixel[i];
599 dL_dalpha += (-T_final / (1.f - alpha)) * bg_dot_dpixel;
600
601 // Helpful reusable temporary variables
602 const float dL_dG = con_o.w * dL_dalpha;
603 const float gdx = G * d.x;
604 const float gdy = G * d.y;
605 const float dG_ddelx = -gdx * con_o.x - gdy * con_o.y;
606 const float dG_ddely = -gdy * con_o.z - gdx * con_o.y;
607
608 // Update gradients w.r.t. 2D mean position of the Gaussian
609 atomicAdd(&dL_dmean2D[global_id].x, dL_dG * dG_ddelx * ddelx_dx);
610 atomicAdd(&dL_dmean2D[global_id].y, dL_dG * dG_ddely * ddely_dy);
611
612 // Update gradients w.r.t. 2D covariance (2x2 matrix, symmetric)
613 atomicAdd(&dL_dconic2D[global_id].x, -0.5f * gdx * d.x * dL_dG);
614 atomicAdd(&dL_dconic2D[global_id].y, -0.5f * gdx * d.y * dL_dG);
615 atomicAdd(&dL_dconic2D[global_id].w, -0.5f * gdy * d.y * dL_dG);
616
617 // Update gradients w.r.t. opacity of the Gaussian
618 atomicAdd(&(dL_dopacity[global_id]), G * dL_dalpha);
619 }
620 }

623void BACKWARD::preprocess(
624 int P, int D, int M, const float3* means3D, const int* radii,
625 const float* shs, const bool* clamped, const glm::vec3* scales,
626 const glm::vec4* rotations, const float scale_modifier, const float* cov3Ds,
627 const float4* conic_opacity, const float* viewmatrix,
628 const float* projmatrix, const float focal_x, float focal_y,
629 const float tan_fovx, float tan_fovy, const float low_pass_2d_kernel_size,
630 const bool mip_splatting_enabled, const glm::vec3* campos,
631 const float3* dL_dmean2D, const float* dL_dconic, glm::vec3* dL_dmean3D,
632 float* dL_dcolor, float* dL_dcov3D, float* dL_dsh, glm::vec3* dL_dscale,
633 glm::vec4* dL_drot, float* dL_dopacity) {
634 // Propagate gradients for the path of 2D conic matrix computation.
635 // Somewhat long, thus it is its own kernel rather than being part of
636 // "preprocess". When done, loss gradient w.r.t. 3D means has been
637 // modified and gradient w.r.t. 3D covariance matrix has been computed.
638 computeCov2DCUDA<<<(P + 255) / 256, 256>>>(
639 P, means3D, radii, cov3Ds, conic_opacity, focal_x, focal_y, tan_fovx,
640 tan_fovy, low_pass_2d_kernel_size, mip_splatting_enabled, viewmatrix,
641 dL_dconic, (float3*)dL_dmean3D, dL_dcov3D, dL_dopacity);
642
643 // Propagate gradients for remaining steps: finish 3D mean gradients,
644 // propagate color gradients to SH (if desireD), propagate 3D covariance
645 // matrix gradients to scale and rotation.
646 preprocessCUDA<NUM_CHANNELS><<<(P + 255) / 256, 256>>>(
647 P, D, M, (float3*)means3D, radii, shs, clamped, (glm::vec3*)scales,
648 (glm::vec4*)rotations, scale_modifier, projmatrix, campos,
649 (float3*)dL_dmean2D, (glm::vec3*)dL_dmean3D, dL_dcolor, dL_dcov3D, dL_dsh,
650 dL_dscale, dL_drot);
651}

422−// Backward pass of the preprocessing steps, except
423−// for the covariance computation and inversion
424−// (those are handled by a previous kernel call)
425−template <int C>
426−__global__ void preprocessCUDA(
427− int P, int D, int M, const float3* means, const int* radii,
428− const float* shs, const bool* clamped, const glm::vec3* scales,
429− const glm::vec4* rotations, const float scale_modifier, const float* proj,
430− const glm::vec3* campos, const float3* dL_dmean2D, glm::vec3* dL_dmeans,
431− float* dL_dcolor, float* dL_dcov3D, float* dL_dsh, glm::vec3* dL_dscale,
432− glm::vec4* dL_drot) {
433− auto idx = cg::this_grid().thread_rank();
434− if (idx >= P || !(radii[idx] > 0)) return;
435−
436− float3 m = means[idx];
437−
438− // Taking care of gradients from the screenspace points
439− float4 m_hom = transformPoint4x4(m, proj);
440− float m_w = 1.0f / (m_hom.w + 0.0000001f);
441−
442− // Compute loss gradient w.r.t. 3D means due to gradients of 2D means
443− // from rendering procedure
444− glm::vec3 dL_dmean;
445− float mul1 =
446− (proj[0] * m.x + proj[4] * m.y + proj[8] * m.z + proj[12]) * m_w * m_w;
447− float mul2 =
448− (proj[1] * m.x + proj[5] * m.y + proj[9] * m.z + proj[13]) * m_w * m_w;
449− dL_dmean.x = (proj[0] * m_w - proj[3] * mul1) * dL_dmean2D[idx].x +
450− (proj[1] * m_w - proj[3] * mul2) * dL_dmean2D[idx].y;
451− dL_dmean.y = (proj[4] * m_w - proj[7] * mul1) * dL_dmean2D[idx].x +
452− (proj[5] * m_w - proj[7] * mul2) * dL_dmean2D[idx].y;
453− dL_dmean.z = (proj[8] * m_w - proj[11] * mul1) * dL_dmean2D[idx].x +
454− (proj[9] * m_w - proj[11] * mul2) * dL_dmean2D[idx].y;
455−
456− // That's the second part of the mean gradient. Previous computation
457− // of cov2D and following SH conversion also affects it.
458− dL_dmeans[idx] += dL_dmean;
459−
460− // Compute gradient updates due to computing colors from SHs
461− if (shs)
462− computeColorFromSH(idx, D, M, (glm::vec3*)means, *campos, shs, clamped,
463− (glm::vec3*)dL_dcolor, (glm::vec3*)dL_dmeans,
464− (glm::vec3*)dL_dsh);
465−
466− // Compute gradient updates due to computing covariance from scale/rotation
467− if (scales)
468− computeCov3D(idx, scales[idx], scale_modifier, rotations[idx], dL_dcov3D,
469− dL_dscale, dL_drot);
470−}
