472−// Backward version of the rendering procedure.
473−template <uint32_t C>
474−__global__ void __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_X* BLOCK_Y) renderCUDA(
475− const uint2* __restrict__ ranges, const uint32_t* __restrict__ point_list,
476− int W, int H, const float* __restrict__ bg_color,
477− const float2* __restrict__ points_xy_image,
478− const float4* __restrict__ conic_opacity, const float* __restrict__ colors,
479− const float* __restrict__ final_Ts, const uint32_t* __restrict__ n_contrib,
480− const float* __restrict__ dL_dpixels, float3* __restrict__ dL_dmean2D,
481− float4* __restrict__ dL_dconic2D, float* __restrict__ dL_dopacity,
482− float* __restrict__ dL_dcolors) {
483− // We rasterize again. Compute necessary block info.
484− auto block = cg::this_thread_block();
485− const uint32_t horizontal_blocks = (W + BLOCK_X - 1) / BLOCK_X;
486− const uint2 pix_min = {block.group_index().x * BLOCK_X,
487− block.group_index().y * BLOCK_Y};
488− const uint2 pix_max = {min(pix_min.x + BLOCK_X, W),
489− min(pix_min.y + BLOCK_Y, H)};
490− const uint2 pix = {pix_min.x + block.thread_index().x,
491− pix_min.y + block.thread_index().y};
492− const uint32_t pix_id = W * pix.y + pix.x;
493− const float2 pixf = {(float)pix.x, (float)pix.y};
494−
495− const bool inside = pix.x < W && pix.y < H;
496− const uint2 range =
497− ranges[block.group_index().y * horizontal_blocks + block.group_index().x];
498−
499− const int rounds = ((range.y - range.x + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE);
500−
501− bool done = !inside;
502− int toDo = range.y - range.x;
503−
504− __shared__ int collected_id[BLOCK_SIZE];
505− __shared__ float2 collected_xy[BLOCK_SIZE];
506− __shared__ float4 collected_conic_opacity[BLOCK_SIZE];
507− __shared__ float collected_colors[C * BLOCK_SIZE];
508−
509− // In the forward, we stored the final value for T, the
510− // product of all (1 - alpha) factors.
511− const float T_final = inside ? final_Ts[pix_id] : 0;
512− float T = T_final;
513−
514− // We start from the back. The ID of the last contributing
515− // Gaussian is known from each pixel from the forward.
516− uint32_t contributor = toDo;
517− const int last_contributor = inside ? n_contrib[pix_id] : 0;
518−
519− float accum_rec[C] = {0};
520− float dL_dpixel[C];
521− if (inside)
522− for (int i = 0; i < C; i++) dL_dpixel[i] = dL_dpixels[i * H * W + pix_id];
523−
524− float last_alpha = 0;
525− float last_color[C] = {0};
526−
527− // Gradient of pixel coordinate w.r.t. normalized
528− // screen-space viewport corrdinates (-1 to 1)
529− const float ddelx_dx = 0.5 * W;
530− const float ddely_dy = 0.5 * H;
531−
532− // Traverse all Gaussians
533− for (int i = 0; i < rounds; i++, toDo -= BLOCK_SIZE) {
534− // Load auxiliary data into shared memory, start in the BACK
535− // and load them in revers order.
536− block.sync();
537− const int progress = i * BLOCK_SIZE + block.thread_rank();
538− if (range.x + progress < range.y) {
539− const int coll_id = point_list[range.y - progress - 1];
540− collected_id[block.thread_rank()] = coll_id;
541− collected_xy[block.thread_rank()] = points_xy_image[coll_id];
542− collected_conic_opacity[block.thread_rank()] = conic_opacity[coll_id];
543− for (int i = 0; i < C; i++)
544− collected_colors[i * BLOCK_SIZE + block.thread_rank()] =
545− colors[coll_id * C + i];
546− }
547− block.sync();
548−
549− // Iterate over Gaussians
550− for (int j = 0; !done && j < min(BLOCK_SIZE, toDo); j++) {
551− // Keep track of current Gaussian ID. Skip, if this one
552− // is behind the last contributor for this pixel.
553− contributor--;
554− if (contributor >= last_contributor) continue;
555−
556− // Compute blending values, as before.
557− const float2 xy = collected_xy[j];
558− const float2 d = {xy.x - pixf.x, xy.y - pixf.y};
559− const float4 con_o = collected_conic_opacity[j];
560− const float power = -0.5f * (con_o.x * d.x * d.x + con_o.z * d.y * d.y) -
561− con_o.y * d.x * d.y;
562− if (power > 0.0f) continue;
563−
564− const float G = exp(power);
565− const float alpha = min(0.99f, con_o.w * G);
566− if (alpha < 1.0f / 255.0f) continue;
567−
568− T = T / (1.f - alpha);
569− const float dchannel_dcolor = alpha * T;
570−
571− // Propagate gradients to per-Gaussian colors and keep
572− // gradients w.r.t. alpha (blending factor for a Gaussian/pixel
573− // pair).
574− float dL_dalpha = 0.0f;
575− const int global_id = collected_id[j];
576− for (int ch = 0; ch < C; ch++) {
577− const float c = collected_colors[ch * BLOCK_SIZE + j];
578− // Update last color (to be used in the next iteration)
579− accum_rec[ch] =
580− last_alpha * last_color[ch] + (1.f - last_alpha) * accum_rec[ch];
581− last_color[ch] = c;
582−
583− const float dL_dchannel = dL_dpixel[ch];
584− dL_dalpha += (c - accum_rec[ch]) * dL_dchannel;
585− // Update the gradients w.r.t. color of the Gaussian.
586− // Atomic, since this pixel is just one of potentially
587− // many that were affected by this Gaussian.
588− atomicAdd(&(dL_dcolors[global_id * C + ch]),
589− dchannel_dcolor * dL_dchannel);
590− }
591− dL_dalpha *= T;
592− // Update last alpha (to be used in the next iteration)
593− last_alpha = alpha;
594−
595− // Account for fact that alpha also influences how much of
596− // the background color is added if nothing left to blend
597− float bg_dot_dpixel = 0;
598− for (int i = 0; i < C; i++) bg_dot_dpixel += bg_color[i] * dL_dpixel[i];
599− dL_dalpha += (-T_final / (1.f - alpha)) * bg_dot_dpixel;
600−
601− // Helpful reusable temporary variables
602− const float dL_dG = con_o.w * dL_dalpha;
603− const float gdx = G * d.x;
604− const float gdy = G * d.y;
605− const float dG_ddelx = -gdx * con_o.x - gdy * con_o.y;
606− const float dG_ddely = -gdy * con_o.z - gdx * con_o.y;
607−
608− // Update gradients w.r.t. 2D mean position of the Gaussian
609− atomicAdd(&dL_dmean2D[global_id].x, dL_dG * dG_ddelx * ddelx_dx);
610− atomicAdd(&dL_dmean2D[global_id].y, dL_dG * dG_ddely * ddely_dy);
611−
612− // Update gradients w.r.t. 2D covariance (2x2 matrix, symmetric)
613− atomicAdd(&dL_dconic2D[global_id].x, -0.5f * gdx * d.x * dL_dG);
614− atomicAdd(&dL_dconic2D[global_id].y, -0.5f * gdx * d.y * dL_dG);
615− atomicAdd(&dL_dconic2D[global_id].w, -0.5f * gdy * d.y * dL_dG);
616−
617− // Update gradients w.r.t. opacity of the Gaussian
618− atomicAdd(&(dL_dopacity[global_id]), G * dL_dalpha);
619− }
620− }
621−}

623−void BACKWARD::preprocess(
624− int P, int D, int M, const float3* means3D, const int* radii,
625− const float* shs, const bool* clamped, const glm::vec3* scales,
626− const glm::vec4* rotations, const float scale_modifier, const float* cov3Ds,
627− const float4* conic_opacity, const float* viewmatrix,
628− const float* projmatrix, const float focal_x, float focal_y,
629− const float tan_fovx, float tan_fovy, const float low_pass_2d_kernel_size,
630− const bool mip_splatting_enabled, const glm::vec3* campos,
631− const float3* dL_dmean2D, const float* dL_dconic, glm::vec3* dL_dmean3D,
632− float* dL_dcolor, float* dL_dcov3D, float* dL_dsh, glm::vec3* dL_dscale,
633− glm::vec4* dL_drot, float* dL_dopacity) {
634− // Propagate gradients for the path of 2D conic matrix computation.
635− // Somewhat long, thus it is its own kernel rather than being part of
636− // "preprocess". When done, loss gradient w.r.t. 3D means has been
637− // modified and gradient w.r.t. 3D covariance matrix has been computed.
638− computeCov2DCUDA<<<(P + 255) / 256, 256>>>(
639− P, means3D, radii, cov3Ds, conic_opacity, focal_x, focal_y, tan_fovx,
640− tan_fovy, low_pass_2d_kernel_size, mip_splatting_enabled, viewmatrix,
641− dL_dconic, (float3*)dL_dmean3D, dL_dcov3D, dL_dopacity);
642−
643− // Propagate gradients for remaining steps: finish 3D mean gradients,
644− // propagate color gradients to SH (if desireD), propagate 3D covariance
645− // matrix gradients to scale and rotation.
646− preprocessCUDA<NUM_CHANNELS><<<(P + 255) / 256, 256>>>(
647− P, D, M, (float3*)means3D, radii, shs, clamped, (glm::vec3*)scales,
648− (glm::vec4*)rotations, scale_modifier, projmatrix, campos,
649− (float3*)dL_dmean2D, (glm::vec3*)dL_dmean3D, dL_dcolor, dL_dcov3D, dL_dsh,
650− dL_dscale, dL_drot);
651−}

36// Helper function to find the next-highest bit of the MSB
37// on the CPU.
18namespace gs {

20// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
21// Binning. Visible Gaussians are sorted by depth; pairs are then emitted in
22// depth order and stably sorted by 16-bit tile id alone.
23
24template <Culling kCulling>
25__global__ void EmitPairsKernel(const Splat* __restrict__ splats,
26 const int32_t* __restrict__ order,
27 const int32_t* __restrict__ inclusive_offsets,
28 int n_vis, Frame frame,
29 uint16_t* __restrict__ keys,
38uint32_t getHigherMsb(uint32_t n) {30 int32_t* __restrict__ values) {
39 uint32_t msb = sizeof(n) * 4;
31 const int k = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
32 if (k >= n_vis) return;
33 int out = k == 0 ? 0 : inclusive_offsets[k - 1];
34 if (inclusive_offsets[k] == out) return;
35 const int i = order[k];
36 const int tiles_x = frame.grid.tiles_x;
40 uint32_t step = msb;37 const Splat s = splats[i];
41 while (step > 1) {
38 ForEachTileRow<kCulling>(s, frame.grid, frame.width, frame.height,
39 [&](int ty, int tx0, int tx1) {
40 const int row_base = ty * tiles_x;
41 for (int tx = tx0; tx < tx1; ++tx) {
42 keys[out] = static_cast<uint16_t>(row_base + tx);
42 step /= 2;43 values[out] = i;
43 if (n >> msb)
44 msb += step;
45 else
46 msb -= step;
44 ++out;
47 }45 }
48 if (n >> msb) msb++;
49 return msb;
46 });
50}47}

52// Wrapper method to call auxiliary coarse frustum containment test.
53// Mark all Gaussians that pass it.
54__global__ void checkFrustum(int P, const float* orig_points,
55 const float* viewmatrix, const float* projmatrix,
56 bool* present) {
57 auto idx = cg::this_grid().thread_rank();
58 if (idx >= P) return;
59
60 float3 p_view;
61 present[idx] =
62 in_frustum(idx, orig_points, viewmatrix, projmatrix, false, p_view);
63}

65// Generates one key/value pair for all Gaussian / tile overlaps.
66// Run once per Gaussian (1:N mapping).
49// Start/end of every tile's run in the sorted pair list. `ranges` must be
50// zeroed beforehand (empty tiles stay [0, 0)).
67__global__ void duplicateWithKeys(int P, const float2* points_xy,51__global__ void TileRangesKernel(const uint16_t* __restrict__ sorted_tiles,
68 const float* depths, const uint32_t* offsets,
69 uint64_t* gaussian_keys_unsorted,
70 uint32_t* gaussian_values_unsorted,
71 int* radii, dim3 grid, int2* rects) {52 int num_pairs, int2* __restrict__ ranges) {
72 auto idx = cg::this_grid().thread_rank();
53 const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
73 if (idx >= P) return;54 if (i >= num_pairs) return;
74
75 // Generate no key/value pair for invisible Gaussians
76 if (radii[idx] > 0) {
77 // Find this Gaussian's offset in buffer for writing keys/values.
78 uint32_t off = (idx == 0) ? 0 : offsets[idx - 1];
79 uint2 rect_min, rect_max;
80
81 if (rects == nullptr)
82 getRect(points_xy[idx], radii[idx], rect_min, rect_max, grid);
83 else
84 getRect(points_xy[idx], rects[idx], rect_min, rect_max, grid);
85
86 // For each tile that the bounding rect overlaps, emit a
87 // key/value pair. The key is | tile ID | depth |,
88 // and the value is the ID of the Gaussian. Sorting the values
89 // with this key yields Gaussian IDs in a list, such that they
90 // are first sorted by tile and then by depth.
91 for (int y = rect_min.y; y < rect_max.y; y++) {
92 for (int x = rect_min.x; x < rect_max.x; x++) {
93 uint64_t key = y * grid.x + x;55 const uint16_t tile = sorted_tiles[i];
94 key <<= 32;
95 key |= *((uint32_t*)&depths[idx]);
96 gaussian_keys_unsorted[off] = key;
97 gaussian_values_unsorted[off] = idx;
98 off++;
99 }
100 }
56 if (i == 0 || sorted_tiles[i - 1] != tile) ranges[tile].x = i;
57 if (i == num_pairs - 1 || sorted_tiles[i + 1] != tile) {
58 ranges[tile].y = i + 1;
101 }59 }
102}60}

104// Check keys to see if it is at the start/end of one tile's range in
105// the full sorted list. If yes, write start/end of this tile.
106// Run once per instanced (duplicated) Gaussian ID.
107__global__ void identifyTileRanges(int L, uint64_t* point_list_keys,
62template __global__ void EmitPairsKernel<Culling::kRect>(
63 const Splat* __restrict__, const int32_t* __restrict__,
64 const int32_t* __restrict__, int, Frame, uint16_t* __restrict__,
108 uint2* ranges) {65 int32_t* __restrict__);
109 auto idx = cg::this_grid().thread_rank();
110 if (idx >= L) return;
66template __global__ void EmitPairsKernel<Culling::kEllipse>(
67 const Splat* __restrict__, const int32_t* __restrict__,
68 const int32_t* __restrict__, int, Frame, uint16_t* __restrict__,
69 int32_t* __restrict__);
11170
112 // Read tile ID from key. Update start/end of tile range if at limit.
113 uint64_t key = point_list_keys[idx];
114 uint32_t currtile = key >> 32;
115 if (idx == 0)
116 ranges[currtile].x = 0;
117 else {
118 uint32_t prevtile = point_list_keys[idx - 1] >> 32;
119 if (currtile != prevtile) {
120 ranges[prevtile].y = idx;
121 ranges[currtile].x = idx;
122 }
123 if (idx == L - 1) ranges[currtile].y = L;
124 }

135CudaRasterizer::GeometryState CudaRasterizer::GeometryState::fromChunk(

137 GeometryState geom;

140 obtain(chunk, geom.internal_radii, P, 128);
141 obtain(chunk, geom.means2D, P, 128);

147 geom.tiles_touched, P);
148 obtain(chunk, geom.scanning_space, geom.scan_size, 128);
149 obtain(chunk, geom.point_offsets, P, 128);
150 return geom;

177// Forward rendering procedure for differentiable rasterization
178// of Gaussians.
179int CudaRasterizer::Rasterizer::forward(
180 std::function<char*(size_t)> geometryBuffer,
181 std::function<char*(size_t)> binningBuffer,
182 std::function<char*(size_t)> imageBuffer, const int P, int D, int M,
183 const float* background, const int width, int height, const float* means3D,
184 const float* shs, const float* colors_precomp, const float* opacities,
185 const float* scales, const float scale_modifier, const float* rotations,
186 const float* cov3D_precomp, const float* viewmatrix,
187 const float* projmatrix, const float* cam_pos, const float tan_fovx,
188 float tan_fovy, const float low_pass_2d_kernel_size,
189 const bool mip_splatting_enabled, const bool prefiltered, float* out_color,
190 int* radii, int* rects, float* boxmin, float* boxmax) {
191 const float focal_y = height / (2.0f * tan_fovy);
192 const float focal_x = width / (2.0f * tan_fovx);
193
194 size_t chunk_size = required<GeometryState>(P);
195 char* chunkptr = geometryBuffer(chunk_size);
196 GeometryState geomState = GeometryState::fromChunk(chunkptr, P);
197
198 if (radii == nullptr) {
199 radii = geomState.internal_radii;
200 }
201
202 dim3 tile_grid((width + BLOCK_X - 1) / BLOCK_X,
203 (height + BLOCK_Y - 1) / BLOCK_Y, 1);
204 dim3 block(BLOCK_X, BLOCK_Y, 1);
205
206 // Dynamically resize image-based auxiliary buffers during training
207 int img_chunk_size = required<ImageState>(width * height);
208 char* img_chunkptr = imageBuffer(img_chunk_size);
209 ImageState imgState = ImageState::fromChunk(img_chunkptr, width * height);
210
211 if (NUM_CHANNELS != 3 && colors_precomp == nullptr) {
212 throw std::runtime_error(
213 "For non-RGB, provide precomputed Gaussian colors!");
214 }
215
216 float3 minn = {-FLT_MAX, -FLT_MAX, -FLT_MAX};
217 float3 maxx = {FLT_MAX, FLT_MAX, FLT_MAX};
218 if (boxmin != nullptr) {
219 minn = *((float3*)boxmin);
220 maxx = *((float3*)boxmax);
221 }
222
223 // Run preprocessing per-Gaussian (transformation, bounding, conversion of SHs
224 // to RGB)
225 FORWARD::preprocess(
226 P, D, M, means3D, (glm::vec3*)scales, scale_modifier,
227 (glm::vec4*)rotations, opacities, shs, geomState.clamped, cov3D_precomp,
228 colors_precomp, viewmatrix, projmatrix, (glm::vec3*)cam_pos, width,
229 height, focal_x, focal_y, tan_fovx, tan_fovy, low_pass_2d_kernel_size,
230 mip_splatting_enabled, radii, geomState.means2D, geomState.depths,
231 geomState.cov3D, geomState.rgb, geomState.conic_opacity, tile_grid,
232 geomState.tiles_touched, prefiltered, (int2*)rects, minn, maxx);
233
234 // Compute prefix sum over full list of touched tile counts by Gaussians
235 // E.g., [2, 3, 0, 2, 1] -> [2, 5, 5, 7, 8]
236 cub::DeviceScan::InclusiveSum(geomState.scanning_space, geomState.scan_size,
237 geomState.tiles_touched,
238 geomState.point_offsets, P);
239
240 // Retrieve total number of Gaussian instances to launch and resize aux
241 // buffers
242 int num_rendered;
243 cudaMemcpy(&num_rendered, geomState.point_offsets + P - 1, sizeof(int),
244 cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost);
245
246 if (num_rendered == 0) return 0;
247
248 int binning_chunk_size = required<BinningState>(num_rendered);
249 char* binning_chunkptr = binningBuffer(binning_chunk_size);
250 BinningState binningState =
251 BinningState::fromChunk(binning_chunkptr, num_rendered);
252
253 // For each instance to be rendered, produce adequate [ tile | depth ] key
254 // and corresponding dublicated Gaussian indices to be sorted
255 duplicateWithKeys<<<(P + 255) / 256, 256>>>(
256 P, geomState.means2D, geomState.depths, geomState.point_offsets,
257 binningState.point_list_keys_unsorted, binningState.point_list_unsorted,
258 radii, tile_grid, (int2*)rects);
259
260 int bit = getHigherMsb(tile_grid.x * tile_grid.y);
261
262 // Sort complete list of (duplicated) Gaussian indices by keys
263 cub::DeviceRadixSort::SortPairs(
264 binningState.list_sorting_space, binningState.sorting_size,
265 binningState.point_list_keys_unsorted, binningState.point_list_keys,
266 binningState.point_list_unsorted, binningState.point_list, num_rendered,
267 0, 32 + bit);
268
269 cudaMemset(imgState.ranges, 0, tile_grid.x * tile_grid.y * sizeof(uint2));
270
271 // Identify start and end of per-tile workloads in sorted list
272 identifyTileRanges<<<(num_rendered + 255) / 256, 256>>>(
273 num_rendered, binningState.point_list_keys, imgState.ranges);
274
275 // Let each tile blend its range of Gaussians independently in parallel
276 const float* feature_ptr =
277 colors_precomp != nullptr ? colors_precomp : geomState.rgb;
278 FORWARD::render(tile_grid, block, imgState.ranges, binningState.point_list,
279 width, height, geomState.means2D, feature_ptr,
280 geomState.conic_opacity, imgState.accum_alpha,
281 imgState.n_contrib, background, out_color);
282
283 return num_rendered;
284}

286// Produce necessary gradients for optimization, corresponding
287// to forward render pass
288void CudaRasterizer::Rasterizer::backward(
289 const int P, int D, int M, int R, const float* background, const int width,
290 int height, const float* means3D, const float* shs,
291 const float* colors_precomp, const float* scales,
292 const float scale_modifier, const float* rotations,
293 const float* cov3D_precomp, const float* viewmatrix,
294 const float* projmatrix, const float* campos, const float tan_fovx,
295 float tan_fovy, const float low_pass_2d_kernel_size,
296 const bool mip_splatting_enabled, const int* radii, char* geom_buffer,
297 char* binning_buffer, char* img_buffer, const float* dL_dpix,
298 float* dL_dmean2D, float* dL_dconic, float* dL_dopacity, float* dL_dcolor,
299 float* dL_dmean3D, float* dL_dcov3D, float* dL_dsh, float* dL_dscale,
300 float* dL_drot) {
301 GeometryState geomState = GeometryState::fromChunk(geom_buffer, P);
302 BinningState binningState = BinningState::fromChunk(binning_buffer, R);
303 ImageState imgState = ImageState::fromChunk(img_buffer, width * height);
304
305 if (radii == nullptr) {
306 radii = geomState.internal_radii;
307 }
308
309 const float focal_y = height / (2.0f * tan_fovy);
310 const float focal_x = width / (2.0f * tan_fovx);
311
312 const dim3 tile_grid((width + BLOCK_X - 1) / BLOCK_X,
313 (height + BLOCK_Y - 1) / BLOCK_Y, 1);
314 const dim3 block(BLOCK_X, BLOCK_Y, 1);
315
316 // Compute loss gradients w.r.t. 2D mean position, conic matrix,
317 // opacity and RGB of Gaussians from per-pixel loss gradients.
318 // If we were given precomputed colors and not SHs, use them.
319 const float* color_ptr =
320 (colors_precomp != nullptr) ? colors_precomp : geomState.rgb;
321 BACKWARD::render(tile_grid, block, imgState.ranges, binningState.point_list,
322 width, height, background, geomState.means2D,
323 geomState.conic_opacity, color_ptr, imgState.accum_alpha,
324 imgState.n_contrib, dL_dpix, (float3*)dL_dmean2D,
325 (float4*)dL_dconic, dL_dopacity, dL_dcolor);
326
327 // Take care of the rest of preprocessing. Was the precomputed covariance
328 // given to us or a scales/rot pair? If precomputed, pass that. If not,
329 // use the one we computed ourselves.
330 const float* cov3D_ptr =
331 (cov3D_precomp != nullptr) ? cov3D_precomp : geomState.cov3D;
332 BACKWARD::preprocess(P, D, M, (float3*)means3D, radii, shs, geomState.clamped,
333 (glm::vec3*)scales, (glm::vec4*)rotations,
334 scale_modifier, cov3D_ptr, geomState.conic_opacity,
335 viewmatrix, projmatrix, focal_x, focal_y, tan_fovx,
336 tan_fovy, low_pass_2d_kernel_size, mip_splatting_enabled,
337 (glm::vec3*)campos, (float3*)dL_dmean2D, dL_dconic,
338 (glm::vec3*)dL_dmean3D, dL_dcolor, dL_dcov3D, dL_dsh,
339 (glm::vec3*)dL_dscale, (glm::vec4*)dL_drot, dL_dopacity);
340}

180− std::function<char*(size_t)> geometryBuffer,
181− std::function<char*(size_t)> binningBuffer,
182− std::function<char*(size_t)> imageBuffer, const int P, int D, int M,
183− const float* background, const int width, int height, const float* means3D,
184− const float* shs, const float* colors_precomp, const float* opacities,
185− const float* scales, const float scale_modifier, const float* rotations,
186− const float* cov3D_precomp, const float* viewmatrix,

192− const float focal_x = width / (2.0f * tan_fovx);
193−
194− size_t chunk_size = required<GeometryState>(P);
195− char* chunkptr = geometryBuffer(chunk_size);
196− GeometryState geomState = GeometryState::fromChunk(chunkptr, P);
197−
198− if (radii == nullptr) {
199− radii = geomState.internal_radii;
200− }
201−
202− dim3 tile_grid((width + BLOCK_X - 1) / BLOCK_X,
203− (height + BLOCK_Y - 1) / BLOCK_Y, 1);
204− dim3 block(BLOCK_X, BLOCK_Y, 1);
205−
206− // Dynamically resize image-based auxiliary buffers during training
207− int img_chunk_size = required<ImageState>(width * height);
208− char* img_chunkptr = imageBuffer(img_chunk_size);
209− ImageState imgState = ImageState::fromChunk(img_chunkptr, width * height);
210−
211− if (NUM_CHANNELS != 3 && colors_precomp == nullptr) {
212− throw std::runtime_error(
213− "For non-RGB, provide precomputed Gaussian colors!");
214− }
215−
216− float3 minn = {-FLT_MAX, -FLT_MAX, -FLT_MAX};
217− float3 maxx = {FLT_MAX, FLT_MAX, FLT_MAX};
218− if (boxmin != nullptr) {
219− minn = *((float3*)boxmin);
220− maxx = *((float3*)boxmax);
221− }
222−
223− // Run preprocessing per-Gaussian (transformation, bounding, conversion of SHs
224− // to RGB)
225− FORWARD::preprocess(
226− P, D, M, means3D, (glm::vec3*)scales, scale_modifier,
227− (glm::vec4*)rotations, opacities, shs, geomState.clamped, cov3D_precomp,
228− colors_precomp, viewmatrix, projmatrix, (glm::vec3*)cam_pos, width,
229− height, focal_x, focal_y, tan_fovx, tan_fovy, low_pass_2d_kernel_size,
230− mip_splatting_enabled, radii, geomState.means2D, geomState.depths,
231− geomState.cov3D, geomState.rgb, geomState.conic_opacity, tile_grid,
232− geomState.tiles_touched, prefiltered, (int2*)rects, minn, maxx);

234− // Compute prefix sum over full list of touched tile counts by Gaussians
235− // E.g., [2, 3, 0, 2, 1] -> [2, 5, 5, 7, 8]
236− cub::DeviceScan::InclusiveSum(geomState.scanning_space, geomState.scan_size,
237− geomState.tiles_touched,
238− geomState.point_offsets, P);

240− // Retrieve total number of Gaussian instances to launch and resize aux
241− // buffers
242− int num_rendered;
243− cudaMemcpy(&num_rendered, geomState.point_offsets + P - 1, sizeof(int),
244− cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost);
245−
246− if (num_rendered == 0) return 0;
247−
248− int binning_chunk_size = required<BinningState>(num_rendered);
249− char* binning_chunkptr = binningBuffer(binning_chunk_size);
250− BinningState binningState =
251− BinningState::fromChunk(binning_chunkptr, num_rendered);
252−
253− // For each instance to be rendered, produce adequate [ tile | depth ] key
254− // and corresponding dublicated Gaussian indices to be sorted
255− duplicateWithKeys<<<(P + 255) / 256, 256>>>(
256− P, geomState.means2D, geomState.depths, geomState.point_offsets,
257− binningState.point_list_keys_unsorted, binningState.point_list_unsorted,
258− radii, tile_grid, (int2*)rects);

260− int bit = getHigherMsb(tile_grid.x * tile_grid.y);
261−
262− // Sort complete list of (duplicated) Gaussian indices by keys
263− cub::DeviceRadixSort::SortPairs(
264− binningState.list_sorting_space, binningState.sorting_size,
265− binningState.point_list_keys_unsorted, binningState.point_list_keys,
266− binningState.point_list_unsorted, binningState.point_list, num_rendered,
267− 0, 32 + bit);

269− cudaMemset(imgState.ranges, 0, tile_grid.x * tile_grid.y * sizeof(uint2));

271− // Identify start and end of per-tile workloads in sorted list

279− width, height, geomState.means2D, feature_ptr,
280− geomState.conic_opacity, imgState.accum_alpha,

283− return num_rendered;
